paragraphs.text: [1] 京都分上、中、下三大区，中京即京都中区。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [2] 收藏在日本高野山金刚峰寺的《古今集》书写断片。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [3] 七福神之一，貌似弥勒佛。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [4] 每年二月首个逢午的日子，是稻荷神社的庙会。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [5] 自京都白川地区到京都市内卖花和蔬菜的女子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [6] 京都特产，芋头和鳕鱼干一起炖煮的吃食。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 京都作为大城市，得数它的绿叶最美。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 修学院离宫、御所的松林，古寺那宽广庭园里的树木自不消说，在市内木屋町和高濑川畔、五条和护城河边的垂柳，都吸引着游客。那是真正的垂柳，翠绿的枝条几乎垂到地面，婀娜轻盈。还有那北山的赤松，绵亘不绝，细柔柔地形成一个圆形，也给人同样的美的享受。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 特别是时令正值春天，可以看到东山嫩叶的悠悠绿韵。晴天还可以远眺叡山 [1] 新叶漫空茏翠。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 树木之清新，大概是由于城市幽雅和清扫干净的缘故。在祇园一带，走进僻静的小胡同里，虽有成排昏暗陈旧的小房子，路面却并不脏。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在和服店林立的西阵一带也是这样，虽挤满了看上去挺寒碜的小铺子，路面却比较干净。即使有小格子，上面也不积灰尘。植物园等地也是如此，没有乱扔的纸屑。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 原先美军在植物园里盖了营房，日本人当然被禁止入内。现在军队撤走了，这里又恢复了本来的面目。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 西阵的大友宗助很喜欢植物园的林荫道。那是樟木林荫道。樟木并非大树，道路也不长，可是他常到这儿散步。在樟木抽芽的时节也……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那些樟树，不知现在怎么样了？”他有时会在织机声中念叨。不至于被占领军伐倒吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 宗助一直等待着植物园重新开放。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 宗助散步，习惯从植物园出来，沿着鸭川岸边再登高一点。这样可以眺望北山的景色。他一般都是独自漫步。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 虽说是去植物园和鸭川，但宗助顶多待一个小时左右。不过，他却十分留恋这样的散步。至今记忆犹新。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生来电话了。”妻子喊道，“好像是从嵯峨打来的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生？从嵯峨打来？”宗助一边说一边向账房走去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 织布商宗助比批发商佐田太吉郎小四五岁，他们之间撇开买卖不说，确是志趣相投。年轻时还算是“老哥儿们”。但是近来多少有些疏远了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我是大友。久违了……”宗助接过电话说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，大友先生。”太吉郎的声调异常高昂。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “听说你到嵯峨去了？”宗助问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我悄悄躲进静荡荡的嵯峨尼姑庵里了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这就奇怪了。”宗助故意郑重其事地说，“不过尼姑庵也有形形色色……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，是名副其实的尼姑庵……庵主上了年纪，由她一个人主持……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那更好嘛。只有庵主一个人，你就可以和年轻姑娘……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “胡扯！”太吉郎笑了，“今天我有点事求你帮忙。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好嘛，好嘛。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我这就上府上去，行吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “欢迎，欢迎。”宗助有点纳闷，“我这儿工作离不开，在电话里你也能听到织机声吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那是织机声啊？实在令人怀念啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “敢情。要是织机声停了，我又不能躲在尼姑庵里，可怎么办呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不到半个小时，佐田太吉郎就坐车到达宗助的店铺。他神采飞扬，马上打开包袱，摊开画稿说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我想拜托你织这个……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？”宗助瞧了瞧太吉郎的脸，“是织腰带吗？对佐田先生来说，这是非常新颖、非常华丽的图案啊。噢，是藏在尼姑庵那个人的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “又来了……”太吉郎笑了起来，“是我女儿的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嘿，织出来了，非把令爱吓一大跳不可。再说，这样华丽的腰带，她会系吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “其实是千重子送了两三册克利的厚画集给我。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “克利？克利是什么人？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “据说是个抽象派先驱画家。他的画，线条柔和，格调高雅，富有诗意，很能引起日本老人的共鸣啊。我在尼姑庵里反复欣赏了好久，然后画出这个图案来。这与日本古典书画的断片全然不同，别具一格啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这倒也是。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “究竟会成个什么样子，我想请你先织出来看看再说。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎那股子兴奋劲儿还没有平静下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 宗助把太吉郎的画稿端详了好一阵子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嘿，真好。色彩调配也……很好。这对佐田先生来说，是过去没有画过的，非常时新。不过画面显得有点素净，怕很难织好呀。就让我用心织织试试看吧。一定会把女儿的孝心和双亲的慈爱表现出来的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢……近来有的人一张嘴就是什么观念啦感受的，往后恐怕连颜色都想流行洋派的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那种东西大概不会太高雅。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我这个人最讨厌带洋名的玩意儿。日本不是自昔日的王朝就有无比优雅的色彩嘛！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “对，拿黑色来说吧，就有各种各样。”宗助点了点头，“尽管如此，今天我也在想：腰带商人中也有像伊津仓先生那样的人……他那里盖了一栋四层楼的洋房，搞现代工业。西阵大概也要那样发展，一天能产五百条腰带，不久的将来，职工还要参加经营。他们的平均年龄，据说都在二十岁上下。像我们这种手织机的家庭手工业，也许用不了二三十年就会全部被淘汰呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “胡说。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就算保全下来，充其量成为国宝罢了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “像佐田先生这样的人，还晓得克利什么的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你是说保罗·克利吗？这条腰带的花样和色彩，都是我隐居在尼姑庵里，经过十天半月的冥思苦想，才设计出来的。你看还算运用自如吧？”太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “相当纯熟，很有日本的风雅。”宗助连忙说，“不愧是出自佐田先生之手啊。就让我来给你织一条漂亮的腰带吧。我要设计个好款式，精心做一做。对了，论手艺，秀男比我好，还是让秀男来织吧。他是我的长子，你知道吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男织得比我精致……”宗助说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “总之，全拜托你了，请织好一点就是。虽然我是个批发商，不过我经售的货物多半是销到地方上去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧您说的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这条腰带不是夏季用而是秋季用的，请你快点织……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，知道了。用什么和服料子配这条腰带呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我只顾考虑腰带了……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你是批发商，可以从许多和服料子中挑最好的……这个好办。看样子你已经在给令爱办嫁妆了嘛。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，不！”太吉郎像是说自己的事似的，脸颊马上泛起了一片红潮。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 据说西阵的手织机是很难连传三代的。因为手织机属于工艺一类，即使父辈是优秀的织匠，从某种意义上说，就是有高超技术的人，也不见得能传给儿子。儿子不能因为父亲的技术高超，自己就可以偷懒；有时即使勤奋学习，还不一定能学到手。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，也有这种情况：孩子到了四五岁，就让他学缫丝。到了十一二岁，开始练习操作机子，然后就可以承揽外租机的活计。因此有许多孩子可以帮助家庭繁荣家业。另外，六七十岁的老太婆也可以在自己家里帮忙缫丝，所以也有的人家是祖母和孙女俩对坐着干活的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 大友宗助家里，只有老伴一人帮忙缫腰带丝。长年累月闷头坐着干活，看上去她要比实际年龄苍老得多，人也变得沉默寡言。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 大友宗助有三个儿子。他们每人操一台织机织腰带。有三台织机，家境当然算好的了，一般人家只有一台，还有的人家是租用别人的机子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 正如宗助所说，长子秀男的手艺超过了父辈，在纺织厂和批发商中间是小有名气的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男，秀男。”宗助呼喊。秀男似乎没有听见。这里又不是摆着好多机械织机，只有三台手织机，而且又是木制的，噪音不会太大。宗助觉得自己的呼喊声已经够大的了。许是秀男的织机安放在靠近院子紧里头，他织的又是难度最大的双层腰带，全神贯注，连父亲的叫喊声也没有听见。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “老婆子，把秀男叫来好吗？”宗助对妻子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。”妻子掸了掸膝盖，下到了土间。向秀男的织机那边走去的时候，她握着拳头不住地捶腰节骨。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男停下操作梭子的手，望了望这边，但他没有立即站起来。也许是太累了，但他知道有客人，又不好意思伸懒腰。他擦了一把脸，就走了过来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这地方太简陋了，欢迎欢迎。”秀男简慢地向太吉郎寒暄了一句，仿佛被工作缠着分不开身似的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生画好了一幅腰带图案，想让咱们家来织。”父亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”秀男还是带着无精打采的口吻。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是一条很重要的腰带，你来织比我织更好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是令爱的腰带吗？”秀男这才将他那白皙的脸朝向佐田望了望。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 作为京都人，宗助看见儿子这副简慢的表情，连忙打圆场说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男从一早就开始干活，怕是累了……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男没有作声。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不卖力气是做不好工作的……”太吉郎倒反过来安慰他。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “织双层腰带即使乏味，也要硬着头皮去织啊。请您原谅。”秀男说着歪了歪脖子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好！一个织匠不这样就不成！”太吉郎连连点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “可那些没意思的东西，还是会被当作我家的手艺，这就更使我难堪了。”秀男说罢，低下了头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男，”父亲改变了语气，“佐田先生的大作可不同啊！这是佐田先生在峨嵯尼姑庵隐居时画出来的画稿，是非卖品。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？噢，是在嵯峨的尼姑庵……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你也看看吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎被秀男的气势所压倒，刚才进大友家时那股威风几乎全没了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他把画稿摊开放在秀男面前。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你不讨厌吧？”太吉郎怯懦地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男不吭声，直勾勾地凝望着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不行吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男执拗地一声不言。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男！”宗助忍无可忍，“快答话呀！这样多不礼貌啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。”秀男还是没有抬脸，“我也是个手艺人，难得让我来看看佐田先生的图案，我觉得这可不是一件一般的活计。是千重子小姐的腰带啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “对呀。”父亲点了点头，可又纳闷，觉得秀男的态度有点异常。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不行吗？”太吉郎又叮问了一句，声音也放粗了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “很好。”秀男稳重地说，“我没说不行呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你嘴上不说，心里却……你的眼睛告诉了我。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你说什么……”太吉郎站起来扇了秀男一记耳光。秀男没有躲闪。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “您尽管打吧。我连做梦也没认为佐田先生的图案不好呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 许是挨了打的缘故，秀男的脸反而显得更有生气了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男挨了耳光，连摸也不摸一下他那被扇红了的半边脸，还向太吉郎道歉：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生，请您原谅。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “您生气了？不过，这条带子还是让我来织吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好吧。我本来就是来拜托你们的嘛。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 于是，太吉郎竭力使自己的情绪平静下来，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “请你原谅。我都这把年纪了，还这样子，实在抱歉。打人的手很疼啊……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “若是借我的手去打就好了。手艺人的手，皮厚。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 两人都笑了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，太吉郎内心那股抵触情绪还没有完全消失。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我已经想不起来多少年没打过人了。这回多蒙你原谅。不过，秀男，我还想问问你，当你看到我的腰带图案时，为什么显得那样古怪。你能不能跟我直言？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。”秀男又沉下脸来，“我还年轻，加上又是个手艺人，不是那么识货。您不是说这是隐居在嵯峨尼姑庵里画出来的吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，今天还要回庵去呢。对了，还要再待半个月左右……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “您还是别这样了。”秀男加强语气说，“回家不好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “在家里安不下心来啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这条腰带花样画得那样花哨，那样鲜艳，我为它的无比新颖感到吃惊。我心想，佐田先生怎么会画出这样美的图案来呢，因此全神贯注地欣赏……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “画面虽然新颖有趣，可是同温暖的心却不大协调，不知为什么，仿佛给人一种荒凉的病态的感觉。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎脸色苍白，嘴唇颤抖，说不出话来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “无论在怎样冷清的尼姑庵里，佐田先生也不至于被狐狸精缠身吧……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔。”太吉郎把那幅图案拉近自己膝旁，看得出神。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “对……你说得好。年纪轻轻的，却很有见地啊。谢谢……让我再好好考虑，重画一幅。”太吉郎说着赶忙把画稿卷起来揣在怀里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，这样就很好。织出来感觉就不同了，水彩和染丝的颜色也……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢。秀男，你能把这张画稿拿去，给我织成某种颜色，用来表达我对女儿温暖的父爱之情吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎嘴上虽这样说，却匆匆告辞，走出门去了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 门前流过一条小河，是具有浓厚京都色彩的小河。岸边的水草也以固有的姿势向水面倾斜。岸上的白墙，可能就是大友的家。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎伸手到怀里，把那张腰带画稿揉成小团，扔到小河里去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 丈夫突然从嵯峨挂来电话，说要她把女儿带来，去御宝 [2] 赏花。阿繁不知如何是好，因为她从来没有跟丈夫去赏过花。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子！千重子！”阿繁求助似的呼唤女儿，“爸爸来电话了，你来接一下……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子来了，她把手搭在母亲肩上，一边接电话。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是，我和妈妈一起去。请您在仁和寺前面的茶馆等我们。好的，尽量快点……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子放下电话，望着母亲笑了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是邀我们去赏花嘛，可妈妈您也真是的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “干吗连我也叫去呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “因为御宝的樱花现在正盛开……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子催促半推半就的母亲出门。母亲还有点莫名其妙的样子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 以城里的樱花来说，御宝的明樱和八重樱是属于晚开的，也许是京都的樱花依依不舍离去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 一进仁和寺的山门，只见左手的樱花林（或称樱花园）开满一簇簇樱花，把枝头都压弯了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，太吉郎却说：“哦，这可不得了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 原来，在樱林路上摆着成排的大折凳，人们喝呀唱的，吵吵嚷嚷，弄得乱糟糟的。还有些乡下老太婆兴高采烈地跳着舞，也有的醉汉打起震耳的鼾声，从折凳上滚落下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这成什么体统！”太吉郎有点扫兴，就地站住了。他们三人终于没有走进花丛。其实，御宝的樱花，他们老早以前就很熟悉了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 深处的树丛中，燃烧着赏花客扔下的垃圾，白烟在缭绕上升。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “咱们找个清静的地方遛遛吧，繁。”太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他们刚要往回走，只见樱花林对面高松树下的折凳旁边，有六七个朝鲜女子身穿朝鲜服装，敲着朝鲜大鼓，跳起了朝鲜舞。这边的情景远比那边的要幽雅得多。透过松林墨绿的枝叶间隙，也可以窥见山樱的花。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子停下脚步，欣赏了一会儿朝鲜舞蹈。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，还是找个清静的地方好啊。植物园怎么样？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，那边可能会好一点。御宝的樱花只要看上一眼，也就算领略到春天的大自然景色啦。”太吉郎说着走出山门，乘上了汽车。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 植物园从今年四月起重新开放。开往植物园的新辟电车，从京都车站频频开出。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “植物园也拥挤的话，咱们就到加茂川 [3] 岸边走走吧。”太吉郎对阿繁说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 汽车在满目嫩叶的市街奔驰。古色古香的房子，看上去要比新建的楼房更能衬托出嫩叶的勃勃生机。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 植物园打门前的林荫道起，就显得宽广而明亮。左边就是加茂川的堤岸。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁把门票掖在腰带里。开阔的景致使她的心情豁然开朗。在批发商店街看见的山，也仅仅是其中一角。何况阿繁很少出店铺到马路上走走呢。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 走进植物园，只见正面的喷泉四周开满了郁金香。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这种景色已经失去了京都的情调，难怪美国人要在这儿盖住宅了。”阿繁说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “喏，最里头就是。”太吉郎答道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 来到喷泉附近，春风轻轻吹拂过来，四处飞溅起小小的水沫。喷泉的左边，修建了一间相当大的钢筋玻璃圆屋顶温室。他们三人没有进去，只是隔着玻璃观赏各种热带植物，因为他们散步的时间很短。路的右边，挺拔的雪杉正在抽芽，下层的枝丫贴近地面伸展开去。它虽是针叶树，但那新芽却悠悠地翠绿，一般来说是不会使人联想到“针”字的。它和落叶松不同，不是落叶树种。假使是落叶松，是不是也有令人着迷的嫩芽呢？

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我与大友先生的公子说了一通。”太吉郎没头没脑地说，“不过，他的手艺比他父亲棒，眼光也很敏锐，能够看透人家的心思。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎喃喃自语，阿繁和千重子当然不太明白他说的什么。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “您看见秀男先生了吧？”千重子问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “听说他是个纺织能手哩。”阿繁只说了这么一句，因为太吉郎向来讨厌人家刨根问底。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 从喷泉右边往前走到尽头，向左拐就是儿童游乐场。频频传来孩子们的嬉戏喧闹声。草坪上还堆放着许多小玩意儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎他们三人从树荫下向右拐，出乎意料地下到了郁金香园。满园怒放着郁金香，美得几乎使千重子叫喊起来。有红的、黄的、白的，还有黑茶花般的深紫色，而且都很大，在各自的园地里争艳斗丽。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，就用郁金香来做新和服的图案吧。只是还嫌俗气点，不过……”太吉郎也叹了一口气。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 如果把抽满嫩芽的雪杉下层的枝丫比作孔雀开屏，又该把这里花团锦簇、竞相怒放的郁金香比作什么呢？太吉郎边想边继续观赏。仿佛空气也染上了绚烂的色彩，直渗到人们的心间。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁同丈夫保持一定的距离，紧挨着女儿身边。千重子心里觉得好笑，脸上却没有表露出来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈，白郁金香园前面那堆人，好像是在相亲哩。”千重子向母亲窃窃耳语。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，可能是吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “咱们去看看吧，妈。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲被女儿拽着袖子走。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 郁金香园前面有喷水池，池中有鲤鱼。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎从椅子上站起身，走近去看郁金香的花。他弯下身子，几乎弯到花丛中，饱览了一番，然后折回母女跟前，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “西方的花再娇艳，也会看腻的。爸爸还是觉得竹林好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁和千重子也站了起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 郁金香园是块洼地，四周有树丛围着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，植物园是西式庭园吗？”父亲问女儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这不太清楚。不过，好像有点西方的味道。”千重子回答说。“为了妈妈，咱们再多待一会儿好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎无可奈何，又在花丛中走起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生……没错，是佐田先生。”有人喊道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “啊，是大友先生。秀男一道来了吗？”太吉郎说，“没想到会在这儿……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “可不，我也没想到……”宗助说着，深深鞠了一躬。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我很喜欢这里的樟树林荫道，一直等待植物园重新开放。这些樟树都有五六十年了。我们是信步走过来的。”宗助又抱歉说，“前些日子，我孩子太不懂礼貌了……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “年轻人嘛，没什么。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你是从嵯峨来的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔，我是从嵯峨来的，阿繁和千重子从家里……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 宗助走到阿繁和千重子跟前，向她们寒暄了一番。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男，你看这郁金香怎么样？”太吉郎多少带点严肃的口吻。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “花是活的。”秀男再次愣头愣脑地说了一句。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “活的？不错，的确是活的。但花太多，都已经有点看腻了……”太吉郎说罢，把脸扭向一边。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 花是活的。它的生命虽然短暂，但活得绚丽夺目。来年再含苞、开花，就像大自然一样充满生机……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎仿佛又挨了秀男一闷棍似的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “只怪自己目光短浅呀。我虽然不喜欢用郁金香做和服和腰带的图案，但是出自名家的手，即使是郁金香图案，也会有长久的生命。”太吉郎的脸依然扭向一边，“就以古代书写断片来说也一样，再没有比这古都的更古老了。这么美的东西，却没人愿意去画，只是临摹。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就拿树来说吧，也没有什么古树比这京都的更古老了，不是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我的话没有那么深奥，我每天嘎嗒嘎嗒地操作织机，没想过这么高深的问题。”秀男说着低下了头，“不过，比如说吧，令爱千重子小姐要是站在中宫寺或者广隆寺的弥勒佛爷前面，她不知要比佛爷美多少倍呢！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这话你说给千重子听，让她也高兴高兴吧。但这比喻太不敢当了……秀男，我女儿会很快变成老太婆的。会很快的。”太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦。我说过郁金香是活的。”秀男加重语气说，“它开花时间虽然短暂，但整个生命的火花却是灿烂的。现在正是开花时节。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那是啊。”太吉郎转过身来，面对着秀男。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我并没有想请您让我织一条能系到孙辈的腰带。我现在……只是希望您能让我织一条哪怕系一年，但系起来称心舒服的就好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “风格高啊。”太吉郎点了点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “没法子。和龙村先生他们不同。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我说郁金香是活的，就是出于这种心情。现在郁金香就是怒放，也难免会有两三片花瓣凋谢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就说落花吧，樱花纷纷扬扬地飘落，自有一番风趣，但不知郁金香怎样？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “花瓣也会四下飘落吧……”太吉郎说，“只是郁金香的花太多了，我有点厌烦。色彩过分鲜艳，反而会令人感到索然无味……也许是我上年纪啦。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “走吧。”秀男催促着太吉郎，“以往拿来我家的腰带，郁金香图案的镂花纸板都不是活的。今天真是饱享眼福了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎一行五人，从低洼的郁金香园拾级而上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 石阶旁边，与其说是围上树篱笆，不如说是雾岛杜鹃团团簇簇，活像一道长堤。现在不是杜鹃花期，但它那小嫩叶子的悠悠绿韵，把盛开的郁金香衬托得更加娇艳。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 登上去，只见右边一片宽阔的牡丹园和芍药园。这些园圃也还没有开花。而且，大概是新辟的，他们对这些园圃都不太熟悉。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，东面可以望见比叡山。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 从植物园的每一个角落，几乎都可以望及比叡山、东山和北山。但是芍药园东面的比叡山，好像就在正面。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也许是由于雾霭浓重，比叡山看起来显得特别低矮。”宗助对太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “有了春霞才显得优美……”太吉郎眺望了一会儿，又说，“不过，大友先生，看了那春霞，你不觉得春天已经渐渐远去了吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “看到那浓雾，反而……春天也即将逝去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”宗助又说，“真快啊，我都还没好好去赏赏花哪。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也没什么新奇的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 两人默默地走了一会儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “大友先生，咱们打你喜欢的那条樟树林荫道走回去吧。”太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “太好了，谢谢。我要是能走走那条林荫道，也就心满意足了。我们来时也是走那条路来的，不过……”宗助说罢，回头问千重子，“你愿意跟我们一起走吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 路旁的樟树，枝干左右盘缠。枝梢上的新叶，还是一片娇嫩，略呈红色。虽然没有风儿，有的枝梢却轻轻地摇曳。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他们五人慢步走着，几乎一句话也没说。在林荫下，各人都涌起不同的思绪。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎的脑子里萦绕着秀男的话。秀男曾说千重子美极了，还把她比作京都最风雅的佛像。难道秀男已被千重子迷到这种程度了吗？

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 假如千重子和秀男结婚，她能在大友纺织厂里占据什么位子呢？要像秀男的母亲那样起早摸黑地缫丝吗？

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎回过头来，看见千重子只顾同秀男说话，不时地点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎心想，即便结婚，千重子也不一定嫁到大友家去，可以把秀男招来当佐田家的养老女婿嘛。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子是独生女。如果把她嫁出去，母亲阿繁不知该有多伤心啊！

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 当然，秀男也是大友的长子。他父亲宗助曾说过，秀男的手艺比自己棒。不过，宗助还有老二、老三嘛。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 此外，佐田家的“丸太”商号，虽说生意已日渐惨淡，甚至连店内的陈旧设备也无力更新，但毕竟是中京的批发商，不同于只拥有三台手织机的纺织作坊。一个雇工都没有，光靠家庭手工，生活也可想而知了。这从秀男的母亲浅子那副表情，以及简陋的厨房就看得出来。即便秀男是长子，但同他们商量商量，说不定会同意让秀男当千重子的入赘女婿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男这孩子很稳重。”太吉郎试探宗助说，“虽年轻，但为人可靠啊。真是……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，谢谢。”宗助若无其事地说，“他干起活来，倒是蛮卖力气的。但在人前净出纰漏，鲁莽……叫人不放心啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那好嘛。我打那次以后，一直挨秀男训……”太吉郎反而高兴地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真是的，请你原谅，那孩子太……”宗助鞠了鞠躬，“连父母的话，他不理解的就不听从。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这很好嘛。”太吉郎点点头，“今天又为什么只带秀男一个人出来呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “如果连他弟弟也带来，家里的织机不就得停下来了吗？加上这孩子个性倔强，我想让他在我喜欢的樟树林荫道上走走，也许能使他受到熏陶，变得温柔些……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这条林荫道真好啊。其实，大友先生，你要知道，我也是受到秀男的好心劝告，才把阿繁和千重子带到这儿来呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真的？”宗助惊讶地瞧着太吉郎的脸，“恐怕是你想见见令爱吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，不！”太吉郎连忙否认。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 宗助回过头看，只见秀男和千重子走在后面，阿繁落在最后。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 走出植物园的大门，太吉郎对宗助说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就坐这辆车子走吧。西阵不远。这工夫我们还要到加茂川边走走……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 正当宗助踌躇的时候，秀男说了一句“那么，我们不客气了”，便让父亲上了车。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 佐田一家站着目送车子。宗助从座位上欠起身子，行了个礼。但秀男只是轻轻点了点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这孩子真有意思。”太吉郎想起扇秀男一记耳光的事来，一边忍住笑一边说，“千重子，你和秀男谈得很投缘呀，他在年轻姑娘面前胆怯吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子的目光里露出腼腆的神色，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “您是说在樟树林荫道上？我只听他讲，不知他为什么兴冲冲地同我谈了这许多……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那是因为他喜欢千重子呗，连这点你都不明白？他曾说你比中宫寺和广隆寺的弥勒佛爷还美哪……连爸爸都吓一跳，那么一个别扭的小伙子，竟会说出这样了不起的话来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子也吃了一惊，脸刷地涨红到耳朵根。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “他和你都说了些什么？”父亲探问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “说了些西阵手织机命运一类的事。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “命运？嗯？”父亲沉思起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “提起命运，好像很深奥。其实，命运……”女儿回答。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 出植物园，右边加茂川的堤岸上立着一排排松树。太吉郎率先穿过松林，下到河滩上。虽叫河滩，其实就是一片长着嫩草的细长的绿野。突然传来一阵流水声。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 一群上了年纪的人坐在嫩草地上，打开了饭盒。也有些青年男女，双双悠然漫步。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 河对岸，在上车道的下面，有块专供游人散步的地方。透过稀稀疏疏的樱树，可以看见后面正中的爱宕山，它与西山相连。河流上游，快贴近北山。这一带是风景区。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “咱们坐下来吧。”阿繁说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 从北大路桥下，可以窥见河边的草地上晾晒着友禅绸子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，到底是春天啊。”阿繁四下看了看，说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “繁，你觉得秀男这孩子怎么样？”太吉郎问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么怎么样？这是什么意思？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “招个养老女婿……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么？为什么突然说起这些事……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “人蛮稳重的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “虽然不错，可是，还得先问问千重子。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子早就说过绝对服从啦。”太吉郎说着望了望千重子，“对吧，千重子。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这种事不能强制呀。”阿繁也看了看千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子低下了头，脑海中浮现出水木真一的身影。那是幼年时代的真一。画眉毛，涂口红，化妆打扮成王朝的装束，乘上了祇园节的长刀花车，这是真一的童男形象。当然，那个时候，千重子也是个小孩子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [1] 比叡山的简称。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [2] 京都仁和寺的别称。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [3] 今京都鸭川的别称。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 自平安王朝始，在京都，论山就得数比叡山，论节日可就算贺茂的节日了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 五月十五日的葵节已经过去了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 打昭和三十一年起，就让斋王 [1] 加入了葵节的敕使队伍。这是古时候的一种仪式，相传斋王在隐居斋院之前，要在加茂川把身体洗净。由坐在轿子上、身穿便礼服的女官领先，女嬬 [2] 和童女等随后，乐师奏着雅乐，斋王则穿一身十二单衣坐在牛车上，游行过去。由于这身装束，加上斋王是由女大学生年纪的人装扮，所以看上去更加风雅华丽。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子的同学中，有个姑娘被选上扮斋王。那时候，千重子她们也曾到加茂的堤岸上观看游行队伍。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在古神社、古寺院甚多的京都，可以说几乎每天都要举行大大小小的节日。翻开日历，整个五月，不是这儿就是那儿，总有热闹可看。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 献茶 [3] 、茶室、郊游临时休息地、茶锅等，总有用场，甚至供不应求。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 今年五月，千重子连葵节也没去参观。五月多雨，是个原因，但是小时候经常被领去参加各种节日，不稀罕了，也是原因之一吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 花固然美，千重子却喜欢去看新叶的嫩绿。高雄附近枫树的新叶自不消说，若王子一带的，她也很喜欢。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 友人从宇治寄来了新茶。千重子一边沏茶一边说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈妈，咱们今年连去看采茶都忘记了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “采茶嘛，现在还有吧？”母亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也许还有。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 那时候，植物园里林荫道旁的樟树正在抽芽，就像花一般美丽，大概也是属于抽芽稍晚的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子的女友真砂子挂来了电话。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，去不去看高雄的枫树嫩叶？”她邀请千重子说，“现在比看红叶的时候人少……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不会太晚吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那儿比城里冷，大概还可以吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，”千重子稍顿了顿，接着又说，“本来看过平安神宫的樱花，就该去看周山的樱花才好呢。可是全给忘了。那棵古树……樱花已经看不成了，不过我想去看北山的杉树。从高雄去很近嘛。望着那挺拔秀丽的北山杉，就感到心情舒畅。你愿意陪我去看杉树吗？比起枫树，我更想看北山的杉树啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子和真砂子觉得既然已经来到这儿，就决定还是去看看高雄的神护寺、槙尾的西明寺和尾的高山寺等处的枫树绿叶。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 神护寺和高山寺的坡道都很陡峭。已经穿上西式夏装、脚蹬矮跟皮鞋的真砂子倒还好，担心的是穿着和服的千重子不知怎么样。她偷偷瞧了一眼千重子。然而，千重子显得毫不费劲的样子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你干吗总是那样瞧着我？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真美啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真美啊！”千重子停住脚步，俯视着清泷川那边说，“本以为树木都已郁郁葱葱，那里会很热闹的，可没想到会这样凉爽啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我是说……”真砂子忍住笑，“千重子，我是说你呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “人世间怎么会有这样的美人儿啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “讨厌鬼！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “素雅的和服在万绿丛中把你的美貌衬托得更加迷人啦。你要是穿上华丽的衣裳，会更加漂亮的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子穿一身不甚鲜艳的紫色和服，系的是她父亲毫不吝惜地剪给她的那条红白相间的腰带。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子登上石阶。她想起，当她注意到神护寺里那幅平重盛和源赖朝的肖像（此画还被安德烈·马尔罗誉为世界名画）上，重盛的脸颊还是什么地方隐约残留着绯红的时候，真砂子也这么说过。而且，千重子从前也听真砂子讲过好几次同样意思的话。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在高山寺，千重子喜欢从石水院那宽阔的廊道上眺望对面的山姿，也喜欢观赏祖师明惠上人树上坐禅的肖像画。在壁龛旁边摊放着一幅《鸟兽戏图》的复制品。她们两人受到了招待，在这条廊道上喝茶。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子不曾从高山寺再往里走。那儿是游人止步的地方。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子记得父亲曾带她到周山赏花，摘了笔头菜就回去了。笔头菜又粗又长。此后，每次到高雄来，哪怕是一个人，她也要到北山的村庄走一趟。如今它已经合并到市里，成了北区中川北山町了。这里只有百二三十户人家，似乎叫作村更合适。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我走惯了路，咱们走走吧。”千重子说，“再说又是这么好的路。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 走到清泷川岸边，有一座陡峭的山逼将过来。不一会儿，就看见一片美丽无比的松林。笔直参天的杉树非常整齐地耸立着，一看就知道是经过人工精心修整的。只有这个村庄才出产这种有名的木材—北山圆木。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 下午三点大概是工间休息的时间，有一群像是割草的女子从杉山上走下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子突然站住，呆呆地凝望着人群中的一个姑娘。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，那个人很像你，跟你长得一模一样不是？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 那姑娘上身穿藏青地碎白花纹的窄袖和服，双肩上斜系着揽袖带 [4] ；下身穿裙裤，系着围裙；手戴手背套，头上还扎了头巾。围裙一直绕到背后，两旁开衩。她身上只有揽袖带和从裙裤露出来的细腰带是带红色的。其他姑娘也是同样的装扮。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 大原女 [5] 或白川女打扮大都相似，像古装玩偶的样子。她们全是穿山上的劳动服，不像是要进城卖东西的模样。可能这就是日本野外或山上的劳动妇女形象吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “像极了。你不觉得奇怪吗？千重子，你好好看看。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子一再说道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”千重子并没认真看，“你啊，别太冒失了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么冒失，那么漂亮的人儿……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “漂亮倒是漂亮，不过……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “简直就像你的异母姐妹啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你，这样冒失。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子被她这么一说，这才觉察到自己失言，太离奇了，她都快要笑出声来，于是又强忍住笑，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “人的相貌，虽也会偶然相像，却没有这么像的啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 那个姑娘和她身边的姑娘们没有注意到千重子她们俩，便擦身走了过去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 那个姑娘把头巾扎得很低，只露出一点前发，几乎遮住了半边脸。不像真砂子所说的，可以看清楚她的脸。也没能相对而视。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 再说，千重子曾多次来过这个村子，看见过男人们把杉树圆木材的树皮粗粗地剥掉之后，再由女人仔细地剥一遍，然后用水或温泉水拌和菩提瀑布的沙子，轻轻地洗刷着圆木的情景。她还模模糊糊地记得那些姑娘的面孔。那些加工活儿都是在路旁或户外进行的，而在这小小的山村里，不至于有那么多姑娘。当然，她也没有把每个姑娘的脸都一一仔细地观察过。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 目送姑娘们的背影远去之后，真砂子也稍稍平静了一些。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真奇怪呀。”她一连说了几遍，然后要仔细打量千重子的脸似的歪了歪头，“的确很像啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么地方像呢？”千重子问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，怎么说呢？总觉得很像。可是，很难具体说什么地方像，也许是眼睛或是鼻子……不过，中京的小姐和山村姑娘当然不一样。请原谅。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你说的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，咱们跟上去，到她家去瞧瞧好吗？”真砂子恋恋不舍似的说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “到她家去瞧瞧好吗”这种话，即使出自开朗的真砂子之口，也仅是说说而已。然而，千重子却放慢了脚步，几乎要停下来。她时而仰望杉山，时而凝视堆放在家家户户门前的杉圆木。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 白杉圆木都是一般粗大，磨得非常好看。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “简直像手工艺品呀。”千重子说，“据说也用它来修建茶室，甚至还远销东京、九州呢……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在靠近屋檐前的地方，整齐地立着一排圆木，二楼也立着一排。有一处人家，二楼那排圆木前面，晾晒着汗衫等衣物。真砂子好奇地望着说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这家人说不定就住在圆木排中呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你真冒失啊，真砂子……”千重子笑了，“在圆木小屋旁边，不是有很好的住家吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔，二楼上还晾晒着衣服呢……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真砂子，你说那位姑娘像我，也是这样信口开河吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那个和这个是两码事。”真砂子认真起来，“我说你像她，你觉得遗憾吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “一点也不觉得遗憾。不过……”千重子说话间，脑子里突然浮现出那姑娘的眼睛来。一个健康的劳动者形象，眼睛里却蕴含着深沉而忧郁的神色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这个村子的女人都很能干啊。”千重子要回避什么似的说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “女人和男人一起干活，没有什么稀奇的。庄稼人嘛，就是那样子。卖菜的、卖鱼的何尝不是……”真砂子轻快地说，“像你这样的小姐才看见什么都钦佩呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “别看我这样，我也会干活呀，你才是个小姐呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，我是不干活的。”真砂子干脆地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “干活，说起来简单……真想让你看看这个村子的姑娘干活的情景。”千重子又把视线投向杉山，说，“已经是开始整枝的时候了吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么叫整枝？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “为了使杉树长好，用刀把多余的枝丫砍掉。人们有时还要使用梯子，有时则像猴子一般从这棵杉树梢荡到另一棵杉树梢……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “多危险啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “有的人一早爬上去，直到吃午饭的时候也不下来……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子也抬头望了望杉山。笔直耸立的一排排树干，实在美极了。残留在树梢顶端的一簇簇叶子，也像是精巧的工艺品。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 山不高，也不太深。山巅上整整齐齐地排列着的一棵棵杉树，仿佛一抬头就可望及。这些杉木是用来修建茶室的，所以杉林的形态看上去也有茶室的情调。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 只是，清泷川两岸的山十分陡峭，坠落在狭窄的盆地上。据说，此地雨量多阳光少，这是栽培有名杉木的天然条件之一。自然也能防风。假使遇上强风，杉树就会从新长的娇嫩地方弯曲或歪扭。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 村子里，只有山脚下和河岸边立着一排房子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子和真砂子一直走到这个小小村庄的尽头，然后再折回来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 那里有一户磨圆木的人家。女人们把泡在水面的圆木拿起来，用菩提瀑布的沙子细心地磨着。这种沙子是红色的，像黏土一样。据说是从菩提瀑布的下游取来的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “如果那种沙子用完了怎么办？”真砂子问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “一下雨，沙又会跟着瀑布一起冲下来，堆积在下游处。”一个年长的女人答道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子心想：回答得多么乐观啊。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，正如千重子所说，这里的女人们干起活来可真卖力气。那圆木有五六寸粗，可能是用来做柱子的吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 据说把磨好的圆木用水洗净晾干，再卷上纸，或者捆上稻草，然后出售。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 一直到清泷川石滩，有的地方还种有杉树。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真砂子看见山上种植的整齐的杉树和屋檐前屹立的成排杉木，不由得想起京都古色古香的房子那一尘不染的红格子门来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 村子入口处，有个叫菩提道的国营公共汽车站。再往上走，可能就有瀑布了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 她们两个人在这儿乘公共汽车回家。沉默了片刻，真砂子猛然说了一句：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “一个女孩子要能像杉树那样得到栽培，挺拔地成长起来就好了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “可惜我们得不到那样的精心栽培啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子都快要笑出声来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真砂子，你有过约会吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔，有过。坐在加茂川边的草地上……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “木屋町的沿河纳凉亭上，客人也多起来。掌灯了，我们得往回走啦，不知道纳凉亭里都是些什么人。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “今天晚上呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “今晚七点半也有约会，现在天还没擦黑呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子很羡慕真砂子这种自由。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子和双亲三个人，正在面对中院的内客厅里吃晚餐。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “今天这瓢正饭馆的竹叶卷寿司是岛村送来的，请多吃点儿。我只做了个汤，请原谅。”母亲对父亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 加吉鱼做的竹叶卷寿司，是父亲最爱吃的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “因为名厨师回来得晚……”母亲指的是千重子，“她又和真砂子去看北山的杉树了……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 伊万里 [6] 瓷盘里盛满了竹叶卷寿司。剥开包成三角形的竹叶，就看见饭卷上放着一片薄薄的加吉鱼。汤主要是豆皮加少许香菇。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎的铺子像正面的格子门那样，还保留着京都批发商的风格，可是现在已经改成了公司，原先的代理人和店员都成了职员，大部分人改成每天从家里来上班，只有从近江来的两三个店员住在镶着小格子窗的二楼上。晚饭时间，后面很安静。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子很爱上北山杉村去。”母亲说，“这是什么道理呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “因为我觉得杉树都长得亭亭玉立，美极了。要是人们的心也都那样，该多好啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那不是跟你一样了吗？”母亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，我的心是弯弯曲曲的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那也是。”父亲插进来说，“无论多耿直的人，也难免有各种各样的想法。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那不也挺好吗？有像北山杉那样的孩子固然可爱，可是没有啊。即使有，一旦遇上什么事，很容易受骗上当。就拿树来说吧，不管它是弯也罢，曲也罢，只要长大成材就好……你瞧，这个窄院子里的那棵老枫树。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子这孩子太好了，你还有什么好说的呢。”母亲泛起了不悦的神色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “知道，我知道，千重子是个正直的孩子……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子把脸转向中院，沉默了一会儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “像那棵枫树多顽强啊，可在我身上……”千重子的话声里带着哀伤的情调，“我顶多就像生长在枫树干小洞里的紫花地丁。哎呀，紫花地丁的花，不知不觉间也凋谢了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真的……明春一定还会重新开花的。”母亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 低下头来的千重子，把目光停在枫树根旁那座雕有基督像的灯笼上。借助屋里的灯光，也看不清那剥蚀了的圣像，但她好想祈祷什么。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈妈，我到底是在什么地方生的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲和父亲面面相觑。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “在祇园的樱花树下呀！”太吉郎断然地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 什么晚上在祇园樱花树下生的，不是有点像《竹取物语》这个民间故事了吗？据说赫映姬就是从竹节之间生出来的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 正因为这样，父亲反而断然说出来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子心想：要是真在樱花树下生的，也许会像赫映姬那样，有人从月宫里下来迎我回去呢。她觉得这种想法有点滑稽，也就没有说出口来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 无论是被遗弃还是被抢，千重子究竟是在什么地方出生的呢？父母不知道。也许连千重子的生身父母是谁，他们都不知道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子后悔问了这些不得体的话。但是，她觉得还是不道歉为好。那么，自己又怎么会忽然问起这个问题？连她自己也不明白，说不定是因为她模模糊糊地想起了真砂子说过的，北山杉村有个姑娘长得跟她一模一样……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子不知往哪儿看好，于是她仰望着大枫树的顶梢。不知是因为月亮出来了，还是闹市区的灯火映照，夜空显得一片白茫茫。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “天空也呈现出夏天的色彩啦。”母亲阿繁也仰望着天空说，“喂，千重子，你就是在这家生的。虽说不是我生的，可是就是在这家生的啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”千重子点了点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 正如千重子在清水寺对真一说过的，千重子不是阿繁夫妇从赏夜樱的圆山公园里抢来的，而是被人扔在店铺门口，太吉郎把她抱回来的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这是二十年前的往事了。当时太吉郎还是个三十岁出头的人，生活相当放荡不羁。妻子不敢轻易听信丈夫的话。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “别说得好听……你抱来的这孩子，说不定是你跟艺伎生的吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不要胡说！”太吉郎变了脸色，“你好好看看这孩子身上穿的，是艺伎的孩子吗？瞧，是艺伎的孩子吗？”太吉郎说着，把婴儿推给了阿繁。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁接过婴儿，把自己的脸贴在婴儿冰冷的脸颊上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这孩子，你打算怎么办？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “到里头再慢慢商量，干吗发愣啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是刚生下来的啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 没找着婴儿的亲生父母，不能收作养女，所以户口册上申报为太吉郎夫妇的亲生闺女，取名千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 按通常说法，抱一个孩子来抚养，便会给这家带一个孩子来，夫妇俩就会生下亲生骨肉。可是，阿繁没有怀上孩子。千重子就作为太吉郎他们的独生女，受到抚育和宠爱。随着岁月的流逝，太吉郎夫妇也不再为这孩子究竟被谁遗弃而烦恼。至于千重子的亲生父母是死是活，更无从知晓。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 当天晚饭后，只拾掇拾掇竹叶卷寿司的竹叶子和汤碗就完了，比较简单，全由千重子一个人负责。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然后，千重子躲到后面二楼自己的寝室里，欣赏父亲带去嵯峨尼姑庵的保罗·克利和夏加尔的画集。后来千重子睡着了。不一会儿，她就被噩梦魇住，发出“啊！啊！”的声音，醒了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，千重子！”从隔壁传来母亲的叫唤声，没等千重子答应，隔扇门就打开了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你做梦啦？”母亲说着走了进来，“是做噩梦？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然后她在千重子的身边坐下，开亮了枕边的电灯。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子已经坐在睡铺上了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哎呀，出这么多汗。”母亲从千重子的梳妆台上拿了一条纱手巾，擦着千重子额上和胸前的汗珠。千重子任凭母亲揩拭。母亲暗自想道：这胸脯多么娇美白嫩啊。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “来，擦擦胳肢窝……”母亲把手巾递给千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢您，妈妈。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “做噩梦啦？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，梦见从高处摔下来……咚的一声就掉进了一个郁绿可怕的无底深渊里。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谁都会做这种梦的，”母亲说，“但总也掉不到底啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，别着凉了，换件睡衣吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子点点头，可是心情还没有平静下来。她刚要站起来，就觉得脚跟有点站不稳。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “得了，得了，妈妈给你拿。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子原地坐着，腼腆而麻利地更换了睡衣。她正要去叠换下来的衣裳，母亲就说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不用叠了，就拿去洗。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲把衣裳拿过来，扔到犄角的衣架上，然后，又坐到千重子的枕边。“做这点梦就……千重子，你不是发烧吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲说着，用掌心摸了摸女儿的额头。非但没有发烧，反而是冰凉的。“大概是上北山杉村去，太累了吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你这副心神不定的神色，妈到这儿来陪你睡。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲说罢，就要去把铺盖搬来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢妈……我已经不要紧了，您放心睡去吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真的？”母亲一边说一边钻进千重子的被窝，千重子把身子挪向一旁。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，你已经这样大了，妈再不能抱着你睡了。啊，多有意思呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，母亲先安稳地睡着了。千重子怕母亲的肩膀着凉似的，用手探了探，然后灭了灯，却辗转不能成眠。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子做了一个长梦。她对母亲说的，只是这个梦的结尾。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 开始，与其说是梦，不如说是介于梦和现实之间，她非常高兴地回想起了今天和真砂子到北山杉村去的情景。说也奇怪，真砂子所说的酷似她的那个姑娘的形象，远比那村庄的情景更清晰地浮现在她的记忆里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 后来，在梦的结尾，她掉进了一个郁绿的深渊里。那绿色也许就是留在她心灵上的杉山吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 鞍马寺举行的伐竹会 [7] 是太吉郎所喜欢的一种仪式。大概是因为它具有男子汉的气魄。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这种仪式，太吉郎年轻时就看过多次，并不觉得新奇。不过，他想带千重子去看看。何况据说今年因经费关系，鞍马寺十月间的火节也不举行了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎担心下雨。伐竹会在六月二十日举行，正是梅雨季节。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.
