paragraphs.text: 那雅致的格子门外还有一层格子门，那里也摆上了折叠椅，而且铺面很深。这种格局，在今天看来，也许是旧时遗留下来的痕迹。秀男觉得疑惑的是，一个富有京都风采、堂堂和服批发商的女儿，同那个在北山杉村圆木厂当雇工的姑娘怎么会是姐妹呢？可是这样的问题，秀男不应该刨根问底。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “腰带织好以后送到这儿来行吗？”秀男说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这……”千重子想了想，然后说，“请直接送到苗子那儿去可以吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “当然可以。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那么就请这样办吧。”她满心诚意拜托了秀男，“只是路远些……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，也不算太远。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子不知道该有多高兴啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “她会接受吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子会感到莫名其妙吧？秀男怀疑是理所当然的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “由我来向苗子好好说明就是。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，那就……一定送去。她家在什么地方呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子也不晓得，所以她说：“苗子她家吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我打电话或者写信告诉你。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？”秀男说，“与其为另一位千重子小姐织，不如单为小姐你织了。我一定精心织好，亲自送去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢。”千重子低头施礼，“拜托你啦，你觉得奇怪吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男先生，这腰带不是织给我，是织给苗子小姐的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，明白了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不大一会儿，秀男就走出店铺，他总觉得这还是个谜。但他毕竟开始动脑子考虑腰带的构图。设计赤松山和杉树山图案，非要有相当的气魄不可。不然，作为千重子的腰带，恐怕太朴素了。在秀男来说，他认为这是千重子的腰带。不，如果是那位叫苗子的姑娘的，就得设计与她劳动生活相近的图案，正如他曾向千重子说过的那样。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男曾在四条大桥上见过不知是千重子化身的苗子，还是苗子化身的千重子。因此，他想到四条大桥走走，于是朝那边走去。但是烈日当头，十分炎热。他凭倚在桥栏杆上，闭上眼睛，想倾听那几乎听不见的潺潺流水声，而不是人潮或电车的轰鸣。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 今年千重子没去看“大字”篝火。母亲阿繁倒少有地跟着父亲去了。千重子留下来看家。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲他们和附近相好的批发商，把木屋町二条下茶馆的房间包了下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 八月十六日的“大字”，就是送神的篝火。传说从前有这样的风俗：夜里将火把抛上空中，送别在空中游荡的鬼魂回阴府，后来由此演变成在山上焚火。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 东山如意岳的“大字”虽是正统，其实是在五座山上焚的火。除了如意岳大字外，还有金阁寺附近大北山的“左大字”、松崎山的“妙法”、西贺茂明见山的“船形”、上嵯峨山的“牌坊形”，这五座山相继焚起火来。在约莫四十分钟的焚火时间里，市内的霓虹灯、广告灯都一齐熄灭。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子看见火光映照的山色和夜空，不由得感受到这是初秋的景象。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 立秋前夕，比“大字”早半个月，下鸭神社还举行了越夏祭神。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子经常邀几位朋友登上加茂川的堤岸，去欣赏“左大字”等。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “大字”这种仪式，千重子从小就看惯了。然而，“今年的‘大字’又……”这种感情，随着年华的增长自然而然地涌上她的心头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子出了店门，和街坊的孩子们围着折叠椅嬉戏耍闹。小孩子们对“大字”之类似乎不太在意，倒是对焰火更感兴趣。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，今年夏天的盂兰盆节，给千重子增添了新的哀伤。因为她在祇园节上遇见了苗子，从苗子那里听说亲生父母早已与世长辞。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “对，明天就去见苗子。”千重子想道，“也要把秀男织腰带的事好好告诉她……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 第二天下午，千重子穿着平淡无奇的装束出门去了……她还不曾在白天里见过苗子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子在菩提瀑布站下了车。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 北山村可能已是繁忙的季节。在那里，男人们正在剥着杉圆木的皮。杉树皮堆积如山，围成的圈子越来越大。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子有点踌躇，刚迈几步，苗子一溜烟似的跑了过来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，欢迎你呀。实在是，实在是好……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子瞅着苗子这副劳动时的模样。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “干完活儿了吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，今天我已经请了假，因为看见千重子小姐……”苗子喘吁吁地说，“咱们就在杉山里谈吧。那里谁都不会看见的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 说着她拽住千重子的衣袖走了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子急忙把围裙解下来，铺在地上。丹波棉布围裙很宽，直绕到她背后，因此足够她们两人并排坐下。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “请坐。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子摘下戴在头上的手巾，用手将头发拢了上去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你来得正好。我太高兴，太高兴了……”苗子用闪烁的目光凝视着千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 一股泥土的馥郁、草木的薰馨，也就是杉山的芬芳扑鼻而来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “坐在这儿，下面一点也看不见啊。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我喜欢美丽的杉林，偶尔也到这儿来。但进到杉山里，这还是头一回。”千重子说着，环视了一下四周。杉树几乎一般粗，坚挺拔立。树林包围着她们俩。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这些杉树都是经过人工修整的。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这些树约莫有四十来年了。它们就要被人砍下来做柱子什么的了。要是留下不伐，也许能长上千年，会长得又粗又高吧。偶尔我也会这样想。比较起来，我还是喜欢原始森林。这个村子，总之就像是在制造剪花 [2] ……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “在这个世界上，要是没有人类，也就不会有京都这个城市。这一带就可能成为自然森林，或者草原荒野，说不定还是野鹿和山猪的天地呢。人类干吗要在这个世界上出现？这是多么可怕啊，人类……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子小姐，你是在考虑这样的问题吗？”千重子感到诧异。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子小姐，你讨厌人吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 两个姑娘所在的杉林，骤然间变得昏暗起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “要下骤雨啦。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 雨水积在杉树末梢的叶子上，变成大粒的珠子落下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 伴之而来的是一阵震耳欲聋的雷鸣。

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “可怕，太可怕了！”千重子脸色煞白，握住了苗子的手。

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，请你把身子蜷缩起来。”苗子说着，趴在千重子身上，几乎把她的整个身体覆盖住了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 雷声越来越凄厉可怕。雷电交加，不时发出天崩地裂似的巨响。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这巨响仿佛冲着这两个姑娘的头顶压下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 雨点敲打在杉树末梢上，沙沙作响。每次闪电，一道亮光直闪到地上，把两个姑娘周围的杉树树干都照亮了。转眼间，美丽笔直的树干也变得令人望而生畏。不容思索，马上又是一阵雷鸣。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，雷好像就要劈过来啦！”千重子说着，把身子缩成一团。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也许会劈过来。但不会劈到我们头上。”苗子加重语气说，“绝不会劈到我们头上！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 于是，她用自己的身子把千重子盖得更加严实了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，你的头发有点湿了。”苗子用手巾揩拂千重子的头发，然后将手巾叠成两半，盖在千重子的头上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “雨点难免要透过去的。但是，小姐，雷绝不会在小姐身上或近旁劈下来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 性格刚强的千重子听到苗子坚定的话声，多少恢复了平静。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢……实在太谢谢你了。”千重子说，“为了保护我，瞧你都湿透了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “工作服嘛，湿了也没关系。”苗子说，“我很高兴啊。”

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，我倒忘了，是把镰刀。刚才我在路边剥杉树皮来着，看见你就飞跑过来，所以还带着镰刀。”苗子这才觉察到自己腰上的镰刀，“多危险啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子说着，将镰刀扔到了远处。那是一把没安木柄的小镰刀。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “等回去时再捡吧。不过，我不想回去……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 雷声仿佛从她们俩的头上掠过。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子脑子里清晰地印上了苗子用身体覆盖自己的形象。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 尽管是夏天，然而山里下过这场骤雨后，还是令人感到连手指尖都有点冰凉了。但千重子从头到脚都被苗子覆盖住，苗子的体温在千重子身上扩散开去，而且深深地渗透到她的心底。这是一股不可名状的至亲的温暖。千重子感到幸福，安详地闭上了眼睛。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，太谢谢你了。”过了一会儿，千重子又说了一遍，“在母亲肚子里，你也是这样护着我的吧。”

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈，我上北山杉村去了。在那里，住着我的姐妹……不知是姐姐还是妹妹，总之我们俩是双胞胎。在今年的祇园节上，我们第一次见面。据说我的生身父母早就不在人世了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这些话对阿繁来说，当然是一个意外的打击。她只顾呆呆地盯着千重子的脸。“北山杉村？……是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我不能瞒着妈妈。我们只见过两面，就是在祇园节那天和今天……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是个姑娘吧，她现在生活怎样？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “在杉村一户人家当雇工干活。是个好姑娘。她不愿上咱家来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔。”阿繁沉默了片刻，说，“你既然了解了，也好。那么，你是……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈，我是您的孩子，请您跟过去一样把我当作您家的孩子吧！”千重子变得认真起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那当然，二十年前你就是我的孩子了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈……”千重子把脸伏在阿繁的膝盖上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “其实妈早就发觉你去看祇园节以后就经常一个人发愣，妈还以为你有了意中人，一直想问问你呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “把那姑娘带到咱家来，让妈看看好吗？等店员下班以后，或者晚上都行。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子伏在母亲的膝上轻轻地摇了摇头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “她不会来的。她还管我叫小姐呢……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”阿繁抚摸着千重子的头发说，“还是告诉妈好。那姑娘很像你吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 丹波罐里的金钟儿又开始吱吱地叫起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [1] 元禄十五年，兵库县赤穗地方的四十七名武士为了替城主报仇，杀了一名诸侯。德川幕府为了惩罚武士“犯上”，强令他们切腹自尽，后埋在泉岳寺内。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [2] 剪下来的带茎鲜花，用以供佛或插花。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 听说南禅寺附近有所合适的房子出售，太吉郎想趁秋高气爽散步之便出去看看。于是，带了妻子和女儿同去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你打算买吗？”阿繁问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “看看再说吧。”太吉郎马上不耐烦地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “听说价钱比较便宜，就是房子小了点。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就是不买，散散步也好嘛。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那倒是。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁有点不安。他是不是打算买了那所房子，每天都到现在这家店铺来上班呢？和东京的银座、日本桥一样，在中京的批发商街有许多老板另外购置房子，然后到店里上班。若是这样，那还好，说明丸太的生意虽已日趋萧条，但手头还是宽裕，可以另外购置一所房子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎是不是准备把这间店铺卖掉，然后在那所小房子里“养老”呢？或者说，他也要趁手头还宽裕，早早下决心？要是这样，丈夫在南禅寺附近的小房子里打算干什么，又怎么生活下去？丈夫已年过半百，她很想让他称心如意地过过日子。店铺是很值钱。虽然那样，单靠利钱生活恐怕也是维持不了。要是有谁能好好运用这笔钱生息，生活也就会过得很舒适了。可是，阿繁一时又想不起那种人来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲虽然没有把这种不安的心情吐露出来，但女儿千重子很理解她。千重子年轻。她看着母亲，眼睛里闪现安慰的神色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 可是话又说回来，太吉郎是开朗而快活的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，要是经过那一带，咱们绕到青莲院去一趟好吗？”千重子在车上请求说，“只是在入口前面……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是樟树吧，你想看樟树吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”父亲猜中了，千重子不禁有点吃惊，说，“是想看樟树啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “走吧，走吧。”太吉郎说，“我年轻时候，也常同朋友在那棵大樟树底下聊天呢。但这些朋友都已经不在京都了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那一带每个地方都令人依恋啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子使父亲勾忆起了年轻时代的往事。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “离开学校以后，我也不曾在白天里看过那些樟树。”千重子说，“爸爸，您知道晚上游览车的路线吗？观光路线中安排了一个青莲院，游览车一开进去，就有几个和尚拎着提灯出来迎接。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 和尚举起提灯照着。要领到大门口，还有相当长一段路程。但可以说是来这儿游览的唯一的情趣。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 根据游览车的导游介绍，青莲院的尼僧们会备淡茶招待。可是当他们被让到大厅来时，却蛮不是那么回事。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “招待倒是招待了，不过那么多人，他们只端上一个上面放满粗糙茶杯的椭圆形大木盘，就匆匆走开了。”千重子笑了，“也许尼姑也混杂在一起，快得连眼也没眨一眨就……真是大失所望，茶都是半凉不热的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那也没法子啊。太周到了，不是花费时间吗？”父亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。那还好。照明灯从四面照着这宽阔的庭院。和尚走到庭院中间，站着讲起来。虽是在介绍青莲院，却是了不起的高谈阔论。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “进庙之后，不知从哪儿传来了琴声。我问朋友，那究竟是原奏呢还是电唱机放的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “然后就去看祇园的舞女，在歌舞排练场上跳它两三个舞。喏，那个叫什么舞女来着？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是什么样子的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “系垂带 [1] 的，可衣衫却很寒碜。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “从祇园走到岛原的角屋去看高级艺伎吧。高级艺伎的衣裳，才是货真价实的呢。侍女们也……在粗大的蜡烛照明下，喏，举行叫什么敬酒的仪式。最后在门口的土间，还让我们看了看高级艺伎盛装游行时的装束。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。就是只给看看这些，也已经够好的了。”太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。青莲院和尚拎着提灯相迎和看岛原角屋的高级艺伎这两个节目倒是蛮好的。”千重子答道，“我记得这些事，好像从前曾说过……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么时候也带妈去看看吧，妈还没有看过角屋的高级艺伎呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲正说着，车子已经到达青莲院前了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子为什么想到要看樟树呢？是因为她曾经在植物园的樟树林荫散过步，还是因为她曾讲过北山的杉林是人工培育，她喜欢自然成长的大树呢？

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 可是，青莲院入口处的石墙边上，只种着四株成排的樟树。其中跟前那株可能是最老的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子他们三人站在这些樟树前凝望着，什么话也没说。定睛一看，只见大樟树的枝丫以奇异的弯曲姿态伸展着，而且互相盘缠，仿佛充满一种使人畏惧的力量。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “行了吧，走吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎说着，迈步向南禅寺走去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎从腰包里掏出一张画着通往出售房子那家的路线图，一边看一边说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “喏，千重子，爸爸对树木不太在行，但樟树是不是南国的树种，生长在气候温暖的地方呢？热海和九州一带都盛产吧？这里的樟树，虽说是老树，但令人感到好像是大盆景一样。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这不就是京都吗？不论是山、是河，还是人，都……”千重子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，是吗？”父亲点了点头，又说，“不过，人也不都是那样的啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不论是当代人，还是历史人物……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这倒也是。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “照千重子说，日本这个国家不也是那样吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子觉得父亲把问题扯远，似乎也自有道理。她说：“但是，爸爸，细看的话，不论是樟树树干也罢，奇特地伸展的枝丫也罢，都令人望而生畏，仿佛有一股巨大的力量，不是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。年轻姑娘也会想到这种问题吗？”父亲回头看了看樟树，然后目不转睛地望着女儿说，“你讲得有道理。万物就像你那头亮乌乌的头发，都在延伸成长……爸爸的脑袋瓜不灵啦，老糊涂啦！不，你让我听到了一番精彩的谈话。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸！”千重子充满强烈的感情，呼喊了父亲。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 从南禅寺的山门往寺院内望去，显得又宁静又宽广。和往常一样，人影稀少。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲一边看通往出售房子那家的路线图，一边往左拐弯。那家的房子看上去确实很窄小，它坐落在高高的土围墙深处。从窄小的便门走到大门，道路两旁绽开了一长溜胡枝子白花。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，真美啊！”太吉郎在门前伫立，欣赏着胡枝子白花，看得都入迷了。他原先是为了买房才来看这所房子的，但现在他已经失去了这份心情。因为他发现贴邻的那间稍大的房子，已经做了饭馆兼旅馆。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，成溜胡枝子白花却令人流连忘返。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎好些日子没上这一带来。南禅寺前附近大街的住家，大多已变成了饭店兼旅馆，他震惊之余，才看到了花。当中有的旅馆已改建得能接待大旅行团，从地方来的学生们熙熙攘攘地进出其间。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “房子挺好，可就是不能买。”太吉郎在种着胡枝子白花那家门前自语道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “从发展趋势来看，整个京都城可能用不了多久，就像高台寺一带那样，都要盖起饭店旅馆啦……大阪、京都之间变成了工业区，西京 [2] 一带交通不便，这倒还好，但那附近还有空地，谁又能保证今后不在那附近盖起怪里怪气的时新房子呢……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲脸上露出了失望的神色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎或许是对那一溜胡枝子白花恋恋不舍，走了七八步，又独自折回去再观赏一番。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁和千重子就在路上等他。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “花开得真美啊！可能在种法上有什么秘诀吧。”太吉郎回到她们两人身边，“倘使能用竹子支撑起来就好了，可是……下雨天，过往的人可能会被胡枝子叶弄湿，不好走铺石路哩。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎又说：“如果屋主想到今年胡枝子会开得更美丽，他大概也不舍得卖掉这所房子吧。可是到了非卖不可的时候，恐怕也就顾不上胡枝子花是凋谢还是纷乱了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那就去吧。但龙村可没什么腰带卖……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这一带是下河原町的高级住宅区。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子一走进店铺，就热心地观看成溜挂在右边、重叠着的女服绸料。这不是龙村的织品，而是“钟纺”的产品。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 阿繁走过来问：“千重子也打算穿西装吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，不，妈妈。我只是想了解了解，外国人到底喜欢什么丝绸。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲点点头。她站在女儿的后面，不时伸手去摸那些绸料。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 仿古代书画断片，以正仓院书画断片为主的织品，挂满了正中的房间和走廊。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这是龙村的织品。太吉郎多次参观过龙村织品展览，还看过原来的古代书画断片和有关目录，脑子里有印象，都叫得上它们的名字，可是他还是一再仔细参观。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是为了让西方人知道，日本也能织出这样的织品。”认识太吉郎的店员说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这些话，太吉郎以前来的时候也听说过，但现在听了还是点头表示赞同。即使是模仿中国的，他也说：“古代真了不起啊……恐怕是千年前的了吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在这里陈列的仿古代大书画断片是非卖品……也有织成妇女腰带的，太吉郎曾买过几条自己喜欢的送给阿繁和千重子。不过，这个商店是做洋人生意的，没有腰带出卖。最大的商品就是大桌布，如此而已。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 此外，橱窗里还陈列着袋、囊一类东西和钱包、烟盒、方绸巾等小玩意儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎索性买了两三条不像是龙村出品的龙村领带，还有“揉菊”钱包。“揉菊”就是在织物上仿制光悦 [3] 在鹰峰做的所谓“大揉菊”纸制手工艺产品，手法比较新颖。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “类似这种钱包，现在在东北一些地方也还有，用结实的日本纸做的。”太吉郎说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，哦。”店员应着，“它同光悦有什么联系，我们不太了解……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在里头的橱窗里摆着索尼牌小型收音机，连太吉郎他们也感到吃惊。这些代售商品，尽管是为了“赚取外汇”，也未免太……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他们三人被请到里面的客厅喝茶。店员告诉他们，曾有好几个外宾在这些椅子上坐过。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 玻璃窗外有一片杉树丛，面积不大，却很稀罕。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这叫什么杉呢？”太吉郎问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我也不晓得……大概是叫什么广叶杉吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪几个字呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “有的花匠不识字，不一定可靠，好像是广大的广，树叶的叶吧。这种树多半是本州以南才有。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “树干是什么颜色……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那是青苔。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 小型收音机响了。他们掉回头去，只见有个年轻人在给三四个西方女子介绍商品。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “呀，是真一的哥哥啊。”千重子说着站起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真一的哥哥龙助也向千重子这边靠过来。千重子的双亲坐在接待室的椅子上，龙助向他们施了个礼。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你接待那些女子？”千重子说。双方一接近，千重子就感到这位哥哥和随和的真一不同，他有一种咄咄逼人的感觉，使人难以同他搭话。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不算什么接待，我是给他们当翻译跑跑腿，因为那位担任翻译的朋友，他妹妹去世了，我替他干三四天。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？他的妹妹……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真一的英语不太好，又害羞，所以只好由我……本来这家商店是不需要什么翻译的……何况这些客人在这家商店里只买小型收音机之类东西，她们是住在都酒店里的美国太太。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “都酒店很近，她们是顺便来看看的。如果她们能仔细看看龙村的织品就好了，可惜只顾看小型收音机了。”龙助低声笑了笑，“当然愿看什么全听她们的便。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我也是头一回看到这里陈列收音机。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不论是小型收音机还是丝绸，都要收美钞。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “方才到院子里去，看到池里有色彩缤纷的鲤鱼，我还想：如果她们详细问起这个，该怎么说明才好呢。可是她们只是夸夸鲤鱼好看就了事，无形中帮了我的大忙。关于鲤鱼的知识，我知道的不多。鲤鱼的各种颜色，用英语该怎么说才确切，我也不晓得，还有带斑纹的彩色鲤鱼……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，我们去看看鲤鱼好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那些太太怎么办？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “让店员去照应她们好啰。也快到时间，该回饭店喝茶了。据说她们已同先生约好，要到奈良去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我去跟父母亲说一声就来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，我也得去跟客人打个招呼。”龙助说罢，走到女人们那边，跟她们讲了些什么。女人们一齐把目光投向千重子。千重子脸上顿时飞起一片红潮。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助立即折回来，邀千重子到庭院去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 两人坐在池边，望着美丽的鲤鱼在池中游来游去，沉默了半晌。龙助冷不丁地说了一句：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，你可以给你家的掌柜……哦，现在是公司的什么专务、常务来点厉害的脸色瞧瞧吗？这套千重子小姐会吧？需要的话，我也可以给你助助威……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这太意外了，千重子感到万分惶恐。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 从龙村回来的当天夜里，千重子做了一个梦—成群色彩斑驳的鲤鱼，向蹲在池边的千重子脚下聚拢过来，相互挤成一堆，有的纵身跳跃，也有的把头探出水面。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 只是这样一个梦。而且都是梦见白天发生的事情。千重子把手伸进池水里，轻轻拨动了一下，鲤鱼就这样迅速聚拢过来了。她有点愕然，对鲤鱼群生出一股无可名状的爱怜之情。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 身边的龙助，似乎比千重子更加惊愕。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你的手有什么香味……或者灵气吧。”龙助说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子感到羞涩，站起来说：“或许是鲤鱼不怕人的缘故。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，龙助目不转睛地盯着千重子的侧脸。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “东山就在眼前了。”千重子避开了龙助的目光。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，你不觉得山色与往常有些不一样吗？已经像秋天……”龙助应道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在鲤鱼梦里，龙助在不在身旁呢？千重子夜半醒来，已经记不清了。她久久难以成眠。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助劝千重子给店里的掌柜“来点厉害的脸色瞧瞧”，可是第二天，千重子却感到难以启齿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 店铺快要打烊时，千重子在账房前坐下。这是一间古色古香的账房，四周用低矮的格子围上。植村掌柜觉察到千重子异乎寻常的举止，便问道：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，有什么事吗……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “请让我看看衣服布料。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐的？”植村如释重负似的说，“小姐要穿自家店铺的布料吗？现在要选，就选过年穿的吧，是要做会客服还是长袖和服呢？哦，小姐过去不都是从冈崎或者雕万那样的染店买吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我想看看自家的友禅。不是过年穿的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，那倒不少。但不知眼前这些是不是能使小姐称心？”植村说着站起身子，唤来了两个店员，耳语几句，然后三个人搬出十几匹布料熟练地在店铺当中摊开让千重子看。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这样的好。”千重子立即决定下来，“能在五天或一周内连夹袍下摆里子都请人缝好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 植村倒抽了一口气，说：“这要得太急了，我们是批发店，很少把活儿拿出去请人缝。不过，行啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 两名店员灵巧地将布匹卷好。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是尺寸。”千重子说着，把一张条子放在植村的桌面上。但是，她并没有走开。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “植村先生，我也想学学，了解了解我们家的买卖情况，请您多指点啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子用恳切的语气说过之后，微微点了点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪里的话。”植村脸部的表情顿时僵硬起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子平静地说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “明天也行，请您让我看看账簿。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “账簿？”植村哭丧着脸说，“小姐要查账吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谈不上什么查账，我还不至于这样狂妄。但是，不看看账簿，我无法了解我们家买卖的情况呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦。有好几种账簿，还有一种应付税务局的账簿。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我们家搞了两本账？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪儿的话，小姐。要是可以伪造账目，那还得请你小姐来造哪。我们是光明正大的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “明天给我看吧，植村先生。”千重子干脆地说过之后，从植村面前走开了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，在你出生前，这个店铺就一直是我植村料理呢……”植村说完，千重子连头也不回。植村用几乎听不见的声音又说：“这是什么意思。”然后，他轻轻咂了咂舌头。“唉，腰真痛啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子来到母亲跟前，母亲正准备晚饭，简直给她吓坏了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，你的话可厉害啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，您吓坏了吗，妈妈？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “年轻人，看起来挺老实的，不过也真可怕呀。妈吓得都发抖了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也是人家给我出的点子。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么？是谁？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是真一的哥哥，在龙村……他告诉我，真一那里，他父亲的生意很兴隆，店里有两个好伙计。他说要是植村不干，他们可以调一个给我们，甚至还说他自己也来帮忙。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是龙助说的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。他说反正要经商，研究生院也可以随时不上……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？”阿繁望着千重子活泼美丽的脸。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不过，植村先生倒没有不做的意思……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “他还说，在种着胡枝子白花那户人家附近，若有好房子，他也想让他父亲买下来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔，”母亲一时几乎说不出话来，“你父亲好像有点厌世思想。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “人家说爸爸这样不是挺好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那也是龙助说的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “妈，刚才您或许都看到了，我请求您同意把咱店里的一块和服料子送给那位杉村姑娘，好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好，好，还送件外褂怎么样？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子避开了母亲的视线。她眼睛里包了一汪泪水。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 为什么叫高机呢？不言而喻，就是因为它是高架手织机。一说是由于手织机安放在挖得很浅的地面上，地里的潮气对丝有好处，所以叫高机。原先有人坐在高机上，现在还有人把沉重的石头装进篮子里，然后吊在高机旁边。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 此外，也还有些纺织作坊兼用这种手工织机和机械织机。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男家只有三台手织机，分别由兄弟三人使用，父亲宗助偶尔也织织，因此在这小纺织作坊比比皆是的西阵，他们的家境还算过得去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子委托织的腰带快接近完成，秀男也就越发高兴了。这固然是因为自己倾以全力的工作快要完成，但更重要的是，由于在梭子穿梭、织机发出的声响中，包含了千重子的音容笑貌。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不，不是千重子，是苗子。不是千重子的腰带，是苗子的腰带。然而，秀男在纺织的过程中，只觉得千重子和苗子变成一个人了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲宗助站在秀男身旁，久久地盯着腰带说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，是条好腰带。花样真新颖啊！”说着他歪歪脑袋问道，“是谁的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是佐田先生的千金千重子小姐的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “花样谁设计的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐想出来的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，是千重子她……真的吗？嗯。”父亲倒抽了一口气，望着还在织机上的腰带，用手摸了摸，“秀男，织得很有功夫呀，这样就行了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男，我以前也跟你讲过，佐田先生是我们的恩人啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “知道了，爹。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔，我是讲过啦。”宗助还是反复地说，“我是从织布工白手起家，好不容易才买到一台高机，有一半钱还是借来的。所以每次织好一条腰带就送到佐田先生那儿去；只送一条难为情，总是在夜里悄悄送去……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生从没表示过难色。后来织机发展到三台，总算还……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “尽管如此，秀男，还有个身份不同啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这我明白，您干吗要说这些呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “因为我觉得你好像很喜欢佐田家的千重子小姐……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “原来是这个。”秀男又动起停住的手脚继续织下去。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 腰带一织好，秀男赶紧把它送到苗子所在的杉村去了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 一个下午，北山的天际出现了好几次彩虹。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男抱着苗子的腰带一走上马路，彩虹就跳入了他的眼帘。彩虹虽宽，色彩却很淡雅，还没有完全画出弓形来。秀男停住脚步，抬头仰望，只见彩虹的颜色渐渐淡去，仿佛要消失的样子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 说也奇怪，在汽车进入山谷以前，秀男又两次看到类似的彩虹。前后三次，彩虹也都没有完全成弓形，有些地方总显得淡薄些。本来这是常见的现象，可是秀男今天却有点放心不下，他心里总嘀咕：“噢，彩虹是吉利的象征呢，还是凶邪的标志？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 天空没有阴沉下来。进入山谷后，类似的淡淡的彩虹好像又出现了。但它被清泷川岸边的高山挡住，难以看清楚。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男在北山杉村下车后，苗子依然穿着劳动服，用围裙擦了擦自己的湿手，马上跑了过来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子刚才在用菩提沙（毋宁说类似红黄色的黏土）精心地洗擦杉圆木。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 虽然还只是十月，山水可也冰凉了。杉圆木在一条人工挖的水沟里漂浮着，水沟的一头有个简单的炉灶，热水可能就是从那里流下来的，冒起了腾腾的热气。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “欢迎你到这深山老林里来。”苗子弯腰施了礼。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子小姐，答应替你织的腰带终于织好，给你送来了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是代替千重子小姐接受的吧，我再也不愿意当替身了。今天光见见你就蛮好的了。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这条是我答应给你织的，而且又是千重子小姐设计的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子低下头说：“秀男先生，不瞒你说，前天千重子小姐店里的人把我的和服乃至草屐全都给我送来了，可是这些东西，我什么时候才穿得着呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “二十二日的时代节穿吧。你出不去吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，可以出去。”苗子毫不犹豫地说，“现在在这儿可能会被人看见的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 她好像正在思索什么，然后又说：“可以到河边小石滩上走走吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这会儿，哪能像上次一样同千重子两人躲进杉山里呢。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男先生织的腰带，我会把它看作是一生的珍宝。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪里，我还要为你织的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子连话都说不出来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子给苗子送和服这件事，苗子寄居的人家自然全都知道了。因此，即使把秀男带到那家去也未尝不可。但是苗子自幼思念同胞姐妹，当她大体了解千重子现在的身份和她家的店铺情况以后，也就心满意足了。她不愿再为一些小事给千重子增添烦恼。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不过，抚养苗子的村濑家拥有杉林产业，在此地也算是不错的，苗子还不辞辛苦地为他们干活，所以即使被千重子知道了，也不至于给他们增加麻烦。也许有杉林产业的人，要比那中等规模的衣料批发商殷实得多。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，苗子却打算今后对同千重子频繁接触、加深往来，更要慎重行事。因为千重子的爱已经渗入她的身心……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 由于这个原因，苗子才邀秀男到河边小石滩上去。在清泷川的小石滩上，凡能种植的地方都种着北山杉树。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “实在冒昧，请你原谅。”苗子说。她毕竟是个女孩子，想快点看到腰带。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “杉山真美啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男抬头望了望山，然后打开布包袱皮，解下纸绳。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这里是背后结成鼓形的地方。这段打算放在前面……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哎哟！”苗子捋了捋腰带，一边看一边说，“把这样的腰带送给我，实在不敢当啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子的眼睛里闪出了光彩。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “工艺不精之辈的手艺，有什么不敢当的呢。新年也快到了，画赤松和杉树还算合时。我本来想把赤松放在后面结成鼓形，可是千重子小姐却说应该把杉树放到后面。到这儿来，我才真正明白了。一听说杉树，就马上联想到它是一棵棵大树、老树，其实……我把它画得比较优雅一点，或许算是作品的特色吧。还用了一些赤松的树干作陪衬……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 当然，画杉树树干，也不是采用原色。在形状和色调上，都下了一番功夫。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真是条漂亮的腰带啊，太谢谢了……可惜像我这样的人，恐怕系不了这么华丽的腰带。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐送给你的和服合身吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我想一定会很合身的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐从小就很会挑选有京都特色的和服布料……这条腰带还没给她看过呢。不知为什么，我总觉得有点不好意思。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这不是千重子小姐设计的吗，有什么不好意思的……我也该请千重子小姐看看才是。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那么，在时代节穿出来好吗？”秀男说罢，把腰带叠好，收入帖纸里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男将纸绳系好。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “请你愉快地接受吧。虽说是我答应给你织，其实是千重子委托我的。你只当我是个普普通通的织布工就是。”秀男对苗子说，“不过，我是诚心诚意为你织的呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子把秀男递给她的那包腰带放在膝上，默不作声。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我刚才讲过，千重子小姐从小就很会挑选和服，她送给你的和服，同这条腰带一定配得上……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他们俩跟前那条浅浅的清泷川，潺潺的流水声隐约可闻。秀男环顾了一下两岸的杉山，然后说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “杉树的树干就像手工艺品般整整齐齐地排列着，这个我想象到了。可是杉树上方的枝叶这样像素淡的花，却没有想到。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子的脸上泛起了愁容。说不定父亲是在砍树梢枝丫的时候，想起了被抛弃的婴儿千重子而伤心，才从一处树梢荡到另一处树梢时不慎摔下来的？那时候，苗子和千重子都还是婴儿，自然什么也不懂。直到长大以后，才从村里人那里听说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 因此，苗子只知道千重子—其实她连千重子这个名字也不知道—同自己是双胞胎，但她是死是活、是姐姐还是妹妹都不晓得。因此她想，哪怕见一次也好；如果能见面，从旁瞧瞧也愿意。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子那间破陋得像棚子似的家，至今依然在杉村里荒废着。因为一个单身少女是无法待下去的。长期以来，由一对在杉山劳动的中年夫妇和他们上小学的女儿住着。当然也没有收他们称得上房租的钱，况且这也不像是能收房租的房子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 只是上小学的这位小姑娘出奇地喜欢花，而这房子旁边又有一棵美丽的桂花树，她偶尔跑到苗子这儿请教修整的方法。于是苗子告诉她：“不用管它就好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，苗子每次打这间小房子门前走过，总觉得自己老远老远就比别人先闻到桂花香。这毋宁说给苗子带来了悲伤。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子把秀男织的腰带放在膝上，感到沉甸甸的。它激起了她万千思绪……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男先生，我已经知道千重子小姐的下落了，以后我尽量不再同她来往。不过，承你的好意，和服和腰带，我穿一次就是……你会理解我的心意吗？”苗子真诚地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “会理解的。”秀男说，“时代节你会来吧。我希望看到你系上这条腰带。但是，不邀千重子小姐来。节日的仪仗队是从御所出发。我在西蛤御门等你。就这样决定下来好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子脸颊泛起淡淡的红晕。好一阵子，她才深深点了点头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 对岸河边的一棵小树，叶子呈红色，映入水中的影子在荡漾。秀男抬起脸来问：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那叶子红得很鲜艳的是什么树呀？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是漆树。”苗子抬起目光回答。这一瞬间，不知为什么，梳理头发的手一颤抖，把黑发结弄散了，长发一直垂落在双肩上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哎呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子倏地满脸绯红，赶紧把头发捋在一起，卷了上去，然后准备用衔在嘴里的发夹别上，可是夹子散落一地，不够用了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男看见她的这种姿态和举止，觉得实在动人。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你也留长发吗？”秀男问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。千重子小姐也没有剪掉嘛。但她很会梳理，所以男人家几乎看不出来……”苗子慌里慌张地连忙戴上头巾，说，“实在对不起。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “在这儿，我只给杉树修饰，而我自己是不化妆的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 尽管这么说，她也淡淡地涂上了口红。秀男多么希望苗子再把手巾摘下来，让他看一眼她那长发垂肩的姿态啊。可是，怎么好开口呢。这点，苗子慌忙戴上头巾的时候就意识到了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 狭窄的山谷西边的山峦开始昏暗了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子小姐，该回去了吧。”秀男说着站了起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “今天也快歇工了……白天变得短啦。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 山谷东边的山巅上，耸立着一排排参天的杉树。秀男透过杉树树干的间隙，窥见了金色的晚霞。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男先生，谢谢你，太谢谢你了。”苗子愉快地接受了腰带，也站起身来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “要道谢的话，请向千重子小姐道谢好。”秀男嘴上虽这么说，但是他为能给这位杉村姑娘织腰带，心中充满了喜悦，感情激动不已。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “恕我唠叨，时代节那天请一定来，别忘了，我在御所西门—蛤御门等你！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好吧。”苗子深深点头，“穿上过去从未穿过的和服，系上腰带，准会很难为情的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在节日甚多的京都，十月二十二日的时代节，同上贺茂神社、下贺茂神社举办的葵节、祇园节一起，被公认为三大节日。它虽然是平安神宫的祭祀，仪仗队却是从京都御所出发的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子一大早心情就不平静，她比约定时间提前半个钟头就到达御所西边的蛤御门阴凉处等候秀男。在她来说，等候男子这还是头一回。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 多亏天气晴朗，万里无云。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 平安神宫是为纪念迁都京都一千一百年而于明治二十八年兴建的，因此不消说，时代节是三大节日中最新的一个。但由于这是庆祝京都建都的节日，所以尽量把千年来都城风俗习惯的变迁在仪仗队中表现出来。而且为了显示各朝代的不同服饰，还要推出为人们熟悉的各朝代人物。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 比如和宫、莲月尼、吉野太夫、出云阿国、淀君、常盘御前、横笛、巴御前、静御前、小野小町、紫式部、清少纳言。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 还有大原女、桂女 [4] 。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 此外还有妓女、女演员、女贩等混杂其中。以上列举了女子，当然还有像楠正成、织田信长、丰臣秀吉、王朝公卿和武将。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这活像京都风俗画卷的仪仗队，相当的长。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 据说从昭和二十五年起，仪仗队才增加了女性，从而增添了节日鲜艳豪华的气氛。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 仪仗队领头的是明治维新时期的勤王队、丹波北桑田的山国队，殿后的是延历时代的文官上朝场面的队伍。仪仗队一回到平安神宫，就在凤辇 [5] 前致贺词。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 仪仗队是从御所出发，最好在御所前的广场上观看。因此，秀男才邀苗子到御所来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子站在御所门阴凉处等候秀男，人群进进出出，十分拥挤，倒也没人留意她。不料却有一个商店老板娘模样的中年女子，大大咧咧地走了过来，说：“小姐，您的腰带真漂亮。在哪儿买的？同和服很般配……让我瞧瞧。”女子说着伸手去摸，“能让我看看背后的带子吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子转过身来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 听见那女子“啊！”的一声赞叹，她心里反而觉得踏实了。因为她穿这身和服，系这种腰带，还是有生以来头一遭。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “让你久等啦。”秀男来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 节日仪仗队出场的御所附近的座位都被佛教团体和观光协会占去了。秀男和苗子只好站在观礼席后面。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子第一次在这么好的位置上观礼，只顾观看仪仗队，差点连秀男的存在和自己身上穿的新衣裳也都给忘了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，她很快就发觉，便问：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男先生，你在看什么呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “看松树的翠绿。你瞧，那仪仗队有了松树的翠绿作背景，衬托得更加醒目了。宽广的御所庭园里净是黑松，所以我太喜欢它啦。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我也悄悄看着苗子小姐，你不觉得吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你多讨厌呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子说着，低下了头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [1] 日本女子一种带端长垂的系腰带法，京都的祇园舞姬仍保留这种系带法。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [2] 京都中京区西部。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [3] 本阿弥光悦（1558－1637），江户初期的艺术家，擅长莳绘、书道和茶道等。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [4] 传诵特殊风俗的巫女，因住京都桂乡而得名。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [5] 天皇所乘的銮舆。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在节日甚多的京都，千重子喜欢鞍马寺的火节胜过“大字”。由于地点不太远，苗子也去看过。但是，以往即使在火节的活动场地擦肩而过，她们俩彼此也不会留意。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 从鞍马道通往寺庙，一路上家家户户扎上松枝，屋顶洒上水。人们从半夜里就举着大大小小各式各样的火把，嘴里喊着“嗨哟嗨哟哟”的呼号，登上鞍马寺。火焰熊熊燃烧。两座轿子出现时，村里（现在是镇）的女人们全体出动去拉轿上的绳子。最后才献上大火把。节日的活动一直持续到天快亮的时分。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不过，这种有名的火节，今年停止举行了。据说是为了什么节约。伐竹节虽照旧进行，可是火节则不举行了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 北野天神的“芋茎节” [1] 今年也取消了。据说是由于芋头歉收，无法装饰芋茎轿的缘故。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在京都，经常举行诸如鹿谷安乐寺的“供奉南瓜”，或莲华寺的“封印黄瓜” [2] 等仪式。这些仪式显示了古都的风貌，也反映了京都人生活的一个方面。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 近年来又恢复了在岚山河流上泛龙舟的迦陵频伽 [3] 和在上贺茂神社院内小河上举行的曲水宴等仪式。这些都是当年王朝贵族的高雅游乐。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 曲水宴，就是身穿古装的人坐在河岸边上，让酒杯从小河上漂过来，在这工夫，或写诗作画，或写别的什么，待漂到自己跟前时，拿起酒杯，把酒一饮而尽，然后又让酒杯漂到下一个地方去。这种事都是由书童侍候的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这是从去年开始举办的盛事，千重子去观看了。本来在王朝公卿前头的是歌人吉井勇（这位吉井勇已与世长辞，不在人世了）。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子今年没去参观岚山的迦陵频伽。她总觉得这些活动缺乏古雅的风趣。因为京都古色古香的盛会很多，她几乎都看不过来呢。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子的母亲阿繁干活勤快，千重子也许是从小就受到她的熏陶，或许是天生的秉性，早早起床就细心地揩拭格子门等。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，时代节你们两人过得真快活啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 刚收拾好早餐的餐桌，真一就挂来电话了。看来真一又把千重子和苗子弄错了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你也去了吗？要是喊我一声就好了……”千重子耸耸肩膀说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我本来是想喊你来着，可是我哥哥不让。”真一毫不拘束地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子有点犹疑，没有告诉真一他弄错人了。但是真一来电话，她可以想象到苗子可能已经穿上了她送的和服，并系上秀男织的腰带，去观看时代节了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子的伴儿肯定是秀男。这件事，千重子一时虽然觉得很意外，但心头很快隐隐涌上一股暖流，她脸上也微微泛起一抹笑容。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这回是千重子朗朗地笑了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真一压低声音说：“这个电话是我替哥哥挂的，现在就换哥哥来讲吧……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “给了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “家母在我背后，正好也听得见，好像边听边替我捏把汗呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那也可能。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯。那就行了。尽管只是说说而已，但说与不说可大不一样啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “然后，还让他把保险柜里的存折、股票、债券之类东西都统统拿出来了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这，真行。千重子小姐真了不起。”龙助忍不住说，“千重子小姐，没想到你这样一个温顺的姑娘竟……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “有，多少有点。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这也是可能的。”龙助在电话里沉默片刻，又说，“太好啦！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子在电话里仿佛感到龙助又在犹豫什么。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，今天中午我想上贵店去看看，不碍事吧。”龙助说，“真一也一道去……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “会碍什么事呢。在我这里，不会有你想象的那种大不了的事。”千重子回答说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “因为你是年轻的小姐呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你说的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “怎么样？”龙助笑着说，“我想在掌柜还没下班之前去。我也要仔细观察观察。千重子小姐不必担心，我看掌柜的神色行事。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “啊？”千重子后头的话说不出来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助家是室町一带的大批发商，伙伴中也有各种各样财雄势大的人。龙助虽正在大学研究院念书，但是店铺的重担自然而然要落在他肩上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “该是吃甲鱼的季节啦。我在北野大市已经订好坐席，请你光临。以我的身份去请令尊令堂，未免太冒失了，所以请你……我还带上我家的‘童男’去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子倒抽了一口气，只“噢”地应了一声。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真一扮“童男”乘坐祇园节的彩车，已是十几年前的事了。然而龙助如今还时不时揶揄真一，管他叫“童男”。或许是真一身上至今还保留着当年那股“童男”般可爱而温存的性格吧……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子对母亲说：“方才龙助来电话，说他中午要和真一上咱家来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？”母亲阿繁显出意外的神色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 下午，千重子上后面楼上化妆，虽不是浓妆艳抹，但也费了一番功夫。她细心地梳理着长发，但总也梳不成称心的发型。要穿的衣裳也不知挑哪件好，挑来挑去，反倒决定不下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子好容易才下楼来，父亲已经出门，不在家了。她在内客厅里把炭火拨弄好，看了看周围，又望了望窄小的庭院。那棵老枫树上长着的苔藓，依然是绿油油的，而寄生在树干上的那两株紫花地丁的叶子，却已经开始枯黄了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在那座雕着基督像的灯笼脚下，一棵小小的山茶花开着红花，红得那样娇艳，甚至比红玫瑰还吸引千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助和真一来了。他们同千重子的母亲郑重地寒暄一番之后，龙助独自一个人走到账房掌柜面前，端端正正地坐下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.
