paragraphs.text: 植村掌柜慌忙走出账房，一本正经地酬酢了一番。他讲了很长时间，龙助也应答了，却一直板着面孔。这种冷漠劲，植村当然看在眼里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 植村寻思：这学生哥想干什么呢？然而他被龙助镇住，又不知如何是好。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助等植村把话头一顿下来，就平静地说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “贵店生意兴隆，太好了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，谢谢，托福了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “家父常说，佐田先生幸亏有你，你有多年经验，真了不起啊……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪里的话。小店不同于水木先生那样的大字号，不值得挂齿啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，不，像我们字号，净是扩张，又是和服料子批发商，又是什么，简直是杂货铺！我并不太感兴趣。要是少了像植村先生这样殷实可靠的人，店铺可就……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 植村正要回话，龙助就站了起来。他哭丧着脸，望着朝千重子和真一所在的内客厅走去的龙助的背影。掌柜明白，说要看账簿的千重子和眼前的龙助之间，暗地里定有某种联系。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助来到内客厅，千重子抬头望着他的脸，仿佛要问什么似的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，我替你跟掌柜说妥了。因为我劝告过你，我有责任。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子低下头来替龙助泡抹茶。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哥哥，你瞧瞧那枫树树干上的紫花地丁。”真一用手指着说，“有两株吧。千重子小姐早在几年前就把那两株紫花地丁看作一对可爱的恋人……但它们俩却是咫尺天涯啊……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “姑娘嘛，总是想入非非。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你说的，叫人多难为情呀，真一。”千重子把泡好的抹茶端到龙助跟前，手微微颤抖着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他们三人乘上龙助店里的车子，向北野六番町的甲鱼铺所在地大市奔去。大市是一家格局古雅的老铺子，旅客尽人皆知。房子破旧，天花板也很低矮。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这里主要是卖炖甲鱼，即所谓甲鱼火锅，其次是杂烩粥。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子感到浑身暖融融的，似是带有几分醉意。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子连脖颈都搽上了一层淡红粉。这脖子又白又嫩，光滑润泽，富有青春的魅力，特别是上了淡红粉，实在美极了。她不时抚摸着脸颊，眼睛里闪露出娇媚的神态。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子不曾喝过一滴酒。然而，甲鱼火锅的汤几乎有一半是酒。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 有车子在门口等候，千重子还是担心自己的脚步打颤。然而，她喜不自禁，话也多起来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真一，”千重子对喜欢侃侃而谈的真一说，“时代节那天你看到在御所庭园里的那一对，不是我，你看错人啦。你是在远处看见的吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不要隐瞒嘛。”真一笑了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我什么都没隐瞒呀。”千重子不知该讲什么好，只是说了声，“其实，那姑娘是我的姐妹。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “什么？”真一摸不着头脑。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子在花季的清水寺曾跟真一谈过自己是个弃儿。这事，真一的哥哥龙助恐怕也有所闻。即使真一没有告诉他哥哥，但两家铺子很近，消息自然会传过去。也许可以这样认为吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真一，你在御所庭园里看到的是……”千重子犹豫了片刻，又说，“是我的孪生姐妹，我们是双胞胎呀！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 真一这是第一次听说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 三人沉默良久。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我是被遗弃的啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “若是真的，那扔在我们店门前就好了……真的，扔在我们店门前就好了。”龙助满怀深情地反复说了两遍。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哥哥，”真一笑了，“那时千重子是刚出生的婴儿，同现在的千重子可不一样呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就算是婴儿，不也很好吗。”龙助说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那是你见了现在的千重子才这么说吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “现在的千重子小姐是佐田先生的掌上明珠，是他精心把千重子小姐抚养成人的啊。”真一说，“那个时候，哥哥也还是个孩子，试问小孩子能抚养婴儿吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “能抚养。”龙助有力地回答。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哼，哥哥总是这样过于自信，不服输。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也许是吧。但我的确希望抚养婴儿时的千重子，相信母亲也会帮我的忙。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子醉意减退，额头变得苍白了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 北野的秋季舞蹈会将持续半个月。在结束的前一天，佐田太吉郎一个人出门去了。茶馆送来的入场券当然不止一张，可是太吉郎不想邀任何人同去。连看完舞蹈回家途中，同几个伙伴到茶馆玩玩，他也感到麻烦。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在舞蹈会开始之前，太吉郎就闷闷不乐地坐在茶席上。今天当班坐在那儿以茶道礼法泡制抹茶的艺伎，也没有太吉郎所熟悉的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在艺伎身边站了一溜七八个少女，大概是帮忙端茶的吧。她们都穿着全套的粉红色长袖和服。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哎哟！”太吉郎差点喊出声来。那姑娘打扮得非常艳美。她不就是那天被这烟花巷的老板娘带去看“叮当电车”，并同太吉郎一道乘过车的那个姑娘吗……只有她一个人穿绿色和服，或许也是在值什么班吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这个绿衣少女把抹茶端到太吉郎面前，她当然要遵守茶道的礼法，板起面孔，不露一丝微笑。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，太吉郎的心情似乎轻松多了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这是一出八场舞剧，名叫《虞美人草图》，是中国有名的项羽和虞姬的悲剧。可是，当演完了虞姬拔剑刺胸，被项羽抱在怀里，在静听思乡的楚歌声中死去，最后项羽也战死沙场一场之后，就转到日本熊谷直实和平敦盛以及玉织姬的戏了。故事是讲熊谷打败了敦盛后，深感人世间变化无常而落发出家，随后到古战场上凭吊敦盛时，发现坟墓周围开着虞美人花，笛声可闻。这时便出现了敦盛的鬼魂，它要求把青叶笛收藏在黑谷寺里，玉织姬的鬼魂则要求把坟边的虞美人花供奉在佛前。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在这出舞剧之后，还演了另一出热闹的新舞蹈《北野风流》。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 上七轩的舞蹈流派，是属于花柳派，同祇园的井上派不同。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎从北野会馆出来以后，顺路到了一家古色古香的茶馆，一个人呆呆地坐在那儿。茶馆的老板娘便问：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “叫个姑娘来？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔，叫那个咬人舌头的艺伎吧……还有，那个穿绿衣、给人端茶的姑娘呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就是坐‘叮当电车’的……好，叫她过来打个招呼就可以了吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在艺伎到来之前，太吉郎一个劲儿喝酒。艺伎一来，他就故意站起来走了出去。艺伎跟着他，他便问道：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “现在还咬人吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你记性真好。不要紧的，你伸出来试试。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我不敢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “真的，不要紧的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎把舌头伸出来，它被另一个温暖柔软的舌头吸住了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎轻轻地拍了拍艺伎的脊背说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你堕落了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这算什么堕落？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎想漱漱口。但是艺伎站在身旁，他也不好这样做。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 艺伎这样恶作剧，是下了很大决心的。对艺伎来说，这是一瞬间的事，也许没有什么意义。太吉郎不是讨厌这年轻的艺伎，也不认为这是卑劣的行为。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎刚要折回客厅，艺伎一把抓住他说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “等等！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然后，她拿出手绢，擦了擦太吉郎的嘴唇。手绢沾上了口红。艺伎把脸凑到太吉郎面前瞧了瞧，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好，这就行了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢……”太吉郎将手轻轻地放在艺伎的肩上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 艺伎留在盥洗间，站在镜前再涂了涂口红。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎返回客厅时，那里已是空无一人。他像漱口似的一连喝了两三杯冷酒。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 尽管这样，太吉郎身上似乎依旧留有艺伎的香气，或许是艺伎的香水味。他感到自己仿佛变得年轻了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他觉得就算艺伎的恶作剧是出其不意，可是自己也未免太冷漠了。这大概是因为自己好久没跟年轻姑娘嬉闹吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 也许，这个二十上下的艺伎是个非常有意思的女人。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 老板娘带着一个少女走了进来。少女还是穿着她那身绿色长袖和服。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “按您要求请她来了，她说只作一般性问候。瞧，毕竟年纪还轻啊。”老板娘说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎瞧了瞧少女，说：“刚才端茶的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”少女到底是茶馆的姑娘，没有显出一点羞怯的样子，“我知道您是那位伯伯才给您端的啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦，那就谢谢你啦，你还记得我吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “记得。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这时艺伎也折回来了。老板娘对她说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生特别喜欢小千子。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦。”艺伎望着太吉郎的脸说，“您很有眼力，不过还得等三年哩。再说，来年春天小千子就要到先斗町去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “到先斗町？为什么？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “她想当舞女去，她说她憧憬舞女的风姿。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？要当舞女，在祇园不是挺好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小千子有个姨妈在先斗町，大概就是这个缘故吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎望着这个少女，暗自想道：这姑娘不论上什么地方，都会成为第一流的舞女。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 西阵纺织业工会采取了前所未有的果断措施，决定自十一月十二日至十九日共八天，停止开动所有织机。十二日和十九日是星期天，实际上是停工六天。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 停工的原因很多，但归根结底是由于经济问题。也就是说，生产过剩，致使库存达三十万匹之多。停工八天，就是为了处理库存和争取改善交易。近来资金周转困难，也是一个很重要的因素。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 自去秋至今春，收购西阵纺织品的公司也相继倒闭了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 据说停机八天大约减产八九万匹。但结果还不错，总算是成功了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 尽管如此，在西阵的纺织作坊街，特别是在小巷里，一看就明白，这些所谓作坊是以零星的家庭手工业居多。他们是紧跟这次统制措施的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 那里布满小房子，瓦顶破旧，屋檐很深。虽是两层楼，却很低矮。小巷更是像荒野一样杂乱无章，连昏暗处也传出织机声。这些织机不都是自家的，恐怕也有租赁来的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，据说申请“免除停机”的只有三十多家。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男家不是织和服料子，而是织腰带的。有高机三台，白天也开亮电灯，安放织机的地方还算明亮，而且后面还有空地。但房子很窄，甚至不知道家里人在什么地方休息、睡觉，不知道那些为数不多而且粗糙的厨具都放在哪里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 秀男身强力壮，有才能，对工作也很热心。不过长年累月坐在高机的窄板上不停地织，恐怕屁股上都长茧子了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他邀苗子去参观时代节的时候，对游行队伍的背景—御所那片宽阔的苍翠松林，比对穿上各种时代服装的游行队伍要感兴趣得多。也许是从日常的生活中解放出来的缘故吧。然而，这一点苗子体会不到，因为她是在山沟沟里，即是在狭窄的山谷里干活……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不消说，自从苗子在时代节系了秀男为自己织的腰带之后，秀男工作起来就更加起劲了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子自从跟龙助、真一兄弟两人上大市以后，时不时心神恍惚，虽然还不算是极度痛苦。她自己似乎也注意到了，这也许是烦恼的缘故吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在京都，十二月十三日“开始年事”，这天已过去了。这里已进入冬季，天气变幻莫测。有时大晴天却下起阵雨，偶尔还夹着雨雪。天晴得快，阴得也快。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 十二月十三日“开始年事”，按京都的风俗习惯，从这天起，得筹备过年，还要开始互赠岁暮的礼物。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 忠实遵守这种规矩的，还得数祇园等花街柳巷。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 每逢这时节，艺伎、舞女等都要到平日照顾她的茶馆、歌舞乐师家或艺伎前辈家去分送镜饼 [4] 。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 接着由艺伎、舞女们挨家道贺，说声“恭喜”。它含有这年承蒙眷顾，得以平安度过，来年还请多多关照的意思。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这天打扮得花枝招展的艺伎、舞女来来往往，比往常任何时候都多。稍稍提前的岁暮活动，把祇园周围点缀得绚丽多彩。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子家的店铺没有这样华丽。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子吃过早饭，独自上后面楼上作简单的晨间化妆。她的手却是漫不经心地动着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助在北野甲鱼铺里说的那番激动的话，始终在千重子内心里翻腾。什么要是千重子还是婴儿的时候被扔到龙助家门前就好了，这句话难道不是相当有分量吗？

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助的弟弟真一是千重子的青梅竹马之交，直到高中都是同学。他性情温柔，尽管他喜欢千重子，可从不曾像龙助那样说出这种令人窒息的话。所以他们相处得很自然。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子梳理好她的长发，披散在肩上，然后下楼来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 就在早餐快要结束的时候，北山杉村的苗子给千重子挂来了电话。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是小姐吗？”苗子叮问了一句，“我想见千重子小姐，有件事要面告，可以吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，我真想念你啊……明天怎么样？”千重子回答。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我随时都可以……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “到我店里来吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “请原谅，别叫我上店里去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你的事我已经告诉母亲。父亲也知道了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “还有店员在吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子沉思片刻，说，“那么，我到你村里去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不过这里很冷……你来，我当然很高兴。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我还想去看看杉树……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？这里不但冷，兴许还会下阵雨呢。请你都准备好。不过，烧火嘛，倒是可以随便烧。我在路旁干活，你来了我马上就知道。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子爽朗地回答。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [1] 京都北野神社每年十月四日举行的神事，用芋茎铺葺神轿轿顶，然后抬着去游街。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [2] 莲华寺每年暑伏的丑日举行的将病灾封印在黄瓜上的仪式。人们从莲华寺请回黄瓜，写上姓名与病况，四日后埋进土里或流放水中，传说将带走病灾。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [3] 佛教中一种想象的神鸟。人面鸟身，生活在雪山或极乐世界里，能发出美妙的声音，令人百听不厌。此处指以此鸟命名的活动。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [4] 供神用的圆形大年糕，通常是上下两个。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子穿上了长裤和厚厚的套头毛线衣。她从没有这样打扮过。厚袜子也很花哨。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲太吉郎在家，千重子跪坐在他面前，向他请安。太吉郎看到千重子这身少见的装扮，不禁瞠目而视。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “要上山去吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊……北山杉村那孩子说想见见我，好像有什么事要跟我说……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？”太吉郎毫不犹豫地叫了一声，“千重子！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那孩子要是有什么苦恼或困难，你就把她带到咱家来……我收养她。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子低下头来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “太好了。有了两个女儿，我和你妈也就不寂寞了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，谢谢您，太谢谢您了。”千重子施了个礼，热泪不禁夺眶而出。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，你是我一手喂奶喂大的，我非常疼爱你。对那姑娘，我也尽量做到一视同仁，不分彼此。她长得像你，一定是个好姑娘。带她来吧。二十年前，我讨厌双胞胎，现在倒无所谓了。”父亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “繁！阿繁！”太吉郎呼喊妻子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，我对您的好意感激不尽。不过，苗子那姑娘是绝不会到咱家来的。”千重子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那又是为什么？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “她大概是不愿意妨碍我的幸福，哪怕是一星半点。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “怎么说是妨碍呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “怎么说是妨碍呢？”父亲又说了一遍，然后歪了歪脑袋。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就说今天吧。我对她说，我爸妈都知道了，请你到店里来吧。”千重子带着含泪欲哭的声音说，“她却顾虑店员和街坊……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “店员算什么！”太吉郎终于提高了嗓门。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我懂得爸爸的心意。今天我不妨去说说看。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好吧。”父亲点点头，“路上当心……还有，你可以把爸爸刚才的话转告苗子那孩子。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “好的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子穿上雨衣，戴上头巾，换了一双雨鞋。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 早晨中京的上空万里无云，可不知什么时候阴沉下来了，说不定北山下着雷阵雨。从城里也可以看见这般天色。要不是京都优美的小山峦挡住，或许还能看到远方天阴得要下雪的样子呢。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子乘上了国营公共汽车。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在北山的中川北山村，有国营和市营两种公共汽车，市营公共汽车开到京都市（已经扩大）北郊的山麓就折回，而国营公共汽车则一直驶至远方的福井县小浜地方。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 小浜坐落在小浜湾的岸边上，从若狭湾向前伸向日本海。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 也许是冬天，公共汽车乘客不多。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 有两个结伴出行的青年人目光炯炯地盯着千重子。千重子有点害怕，赶紧蒙上头巾。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，请你不要用那种东西蒙起来嘛。”其中一个青年用跟年轻人很不相称的沙哑声音说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “喂，住嘴！”贴邻的另一个青年说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 请求千重子的那个年轻人手戴镣铐，不知是什么罪犯。他身旁的另一个男人可能是个刑警。大概是要翻过这深山老林，把犯人押送到什么地方去吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子不能摘下头巾让他们看见自己的脸。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 公共汽车到达了高雄。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “到了高雄的什么地方啦？”有个客人问。其实还不至于认不出来。枫叶已经全部落光，从树梢的细枝上可以看到冬天的景象。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在松尾树下的停车场上，一辆车子也没有了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子身穿劳动服来到菩提瀑布停车场迎候千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，欢迎你。很高兴地欢迎你到这深山里来。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “算不了什么深山嘛。”千重子戴着手套就去握住苗子的双手，说，“真高兴啊，打夏天以后就再没见过面啦。那次在杉山里，太感谢你了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那算不了什么。”苗子说，“不过，那时万一响雷真的打在我们俩身上，真不知成什么样子了。尽管这样，我还是很高兴……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，”千重子边走边说，“你给我挂电话，一定有什么急事吧，快告诉我！要不，也塌不下心来聊天哪。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子身穿劳动服，头上包着一条头巾。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “究竟是什么事嘛？”千重子再问了一问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “其实，是秀男向我求婚，我想同你商量，所以……”苗子绊了一跤，差点摔倒，一把抓住了千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子把摇摇晃晃的苗子抱住。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子每天劳动，身体很健壮……可是，那回夏天打雷的时候，千重子一味害怕，不曾留意到。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子很快就站稳脚跟，可是她好像很愿意被千重子拥抱，不肯说声行了，甚至索性依偎着千重子走起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 搂着苗子的千重子，不知不觉反而更多地靠在苗子身上。不过，这两个姑娘谁都没注意到。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子把头巾拉起来，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，那你是怎样回答秀男的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “回答？……我总不能当面回答呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “起初他把我错认是你……现在弄清楚了，他已经把你深深印在心上了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪有这种事。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，我非常了解这点。即使不认错人，我也只是替代千重子小姐罢了。秀男一定把我看作千重子的幻影吧。这是第一……”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 现在千重子回想起这样一件事来：今年春上郁金香盛开的时候，从植物园回家途中，在加茂川堤岸上，父亲曾劝母亲把秀男招为自己的入赘女婿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “第二，秀男家是织腰带的。”苗子加强语气，“如果由于这件事使千重子小姐家的店铺和我发生了关系，增加了千重子小姐的麻烦，甚或使千重子小姐遭到街坊的冷眼，那我可就罪该万死。我真想躲到更深更深的深山里去……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你是这样看的吗？”千重子摇了摇苗子的肩膀，“今天我是对父亲说明了要上你这儿来的。我母亲也很理解。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你猜我父亲怎么说。”千重子更使劲地摇晃着苗子的肩膀，“他说，你去对苗子姑娘说，要是她有什么苦恼或困难，就把她带到咱家来……你是作为亲生女儿入了父亲户口的。不过对那姑娘也要尽量做到一视同仁，不分彼此呀。千重子一个人太寂寞了吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子摘下蒙在头上的头巾，说了声“谢谢”，就把脸捂了起来，好大一会儿说不出话。“我衷心感激你。我的确是个举目无亲、孤苦伶仃的人，虽然寂寞，但我埋头干活，把这些都忘掉了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子为了缓和苗子的激动，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “关键是秀男，他的事……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这样的事，我不能马上回答。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子直勾勾地望着千重子，眼眶里噙满了热泪。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “借我这个。”千重子用苗子的手巾替她揩拭眼圈和脸颊，说，“满面泪痕，能进村吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “没关系。我这个人性格倔强，比谁都能干活，就是好哭。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 当千重子给苗子揩脸的时候，苗子反而情不自禁地投到千重子怀里抽泣起来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这可怎么办呢？苗子，你叫我心里空落落的，快别这样。”千重子轻轻地拍了拍苗子的后背，“你要是这样哭，我可就回去啦。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，不要！”苗子愕然，从千重子手里拿过自己的手巾，使劲擦了一把脸。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 多亏是冬天，人们觉察不出来。只是她的眼白有点红罢了。苗子将头巾戴得低低的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 两人默默地走了一段路程。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 的确，北山杉树的枝丫一直修整到树梢。在千重子看来，呈圆形残留在树梢上的叶子，就像是一朵朵淡雅的冬天的绿花。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子认为此刻正是好时机，便对苗子说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “秀男不仅腰带图案画得好，而且织功也很到家，很认真哩。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，这我知道。”苗子回答，“秀男邀我去参观时代节的时候，他好像不大爱看盛装的游行队伍，倒是很喜欢队伍的背景—御所那松树的苍翠和东山那变幻莫测的色彩。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “时代节的队伍，秀男可能不稀罕……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，好像不是这样的。”苗子加重了语气。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “他要我游行结束以后到家里去一趟。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “家？是秀男的家吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子有点吃惊的样子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “他还有两个弟弟。还领我去看后院的空地，说如果我们将来结合了，可以在那儿盖间小屋，尽量织点自己喜欢的东西。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这不是挺好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “挺好？……秀男把我看作是小姐你的幻影，才要同我结合的呀！我是个女孩子，我很了解这点。”苗子又重复了一遍。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子不知怎样回答才好，她迷惑地走着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 狭长的山谷旁边一个小山谷里，洗刷杉圆木的女工们围坐成一个大圈休息，烤火取暖。篝火燃得烟雾腾腾。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子来到自己的家门前。与其说是家，不如说是个小窝棚。年久失修的稻草屋顶，已经变得歪歪斜斜。只因为是山间房子，所以还有个小院落。院落里的野生南天竹，结着红色的果实。就是那么七八棵，也长得杂乱无章。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然而，这可怜的房子，也许就是千重子原来的家。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 走过这所房子的时候，苗子的泪痕已经干了。究竟对千重子说这就是我们的家好呢，还是不说好？千重子是在母亲的娘家出生的，大概没在这所房子住过。苗子还是婴儿的时候，母亲先于父亲与世长辞，所以连她也记不清自己是否在这所房子住过了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 幸好千重子没发现这样一所房子，她只顾抬头仰望杉山和并排的杉圆木，就径直走了过去。苗子也就没有谈及这所房子的事。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 挺拔的杉林，树梢上还残留着的叶子稍呈圆形，千重子把它看成是“冬天的花”。想来它也的确是冬天的花。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 大部分人家的房檐前和楼上，都晾晒着一排剥了皮的洗刷干净的杉圆木。光是把那一根根白圆木整整齐齐地排成一排立着，就够美的了。也许比任何墙壁都要美得多。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 杉山上，在杉树根旁长着的野草，都已经枯萎。杉树的树干笔直，而且一般粗细，确实很美。透过斑斑驳驳的树干的缝隙，还可以窥见天空。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “还是冬天美啊。”千重子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “可能是吧，我看惯了倒也不觉得。但还是冬天的杉叶看上去有点像淡淡的芒草色。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “它多像花啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “花！是花吗？”苗子感到意外，抬眼望着杉山。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 走不多久，有一间古雅的房子，可能是这村子里拥有山地的大户人家的。略矮的墙壁，下半截镶木板，漆成黄红色；上半截是白墙，带葺瓦的小屋顶。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子停下脚步说：“这间房子真好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，我就是在这家寄居的，请进去看看吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不要紧的。我住在这儿已经快十年了。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子已经听苗子说过两三遍：与其说秀男是把苗子当作千重子的化身，莫如说是当作千重子的幻影，才要同苗子结合的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 如果说是“化身”，那当然容易明白。然而说是“幻影”，究竟是指什么呢……特别是作为结婚对象……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，你总说幻影、幻影的，究竟幻影是什么呢？”千重子严肃地说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “幻影不就是手触摸不到的无形的东西吗？”千重子继续说着，突然涨红了脸。苗子不仅是脸，恐怕全身各个部分都像自己。她将要属于男人所有了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “尽管如此，很可能无形的幻影就在这里。”苗子答话说，“幻影，也许就隐藏在男人的心里、脑子里，或者别的什么地方。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也许我变成六十岁老太婆的时候，幻影中的千重子小姐还是现在这样年轻呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子这句话使千重子感到意外。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你连这样的事都想到了？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “对美的幻影，总没有厌倦的时候吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那也不见得。”千重子好不容易才说出这句话来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “幻影是不能践踏的。践踏了只能自食其果。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “唔。”千重子看出苗子也有妒忌心，但她说，“真是的，什么幻影，在哪儿呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “就在这儿……”苗子说着摇了摇千重子的上身。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我不是幻影。是和你成对的双胞胎。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这么说，莫非你还要同我的灵魂做姐妹不成？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “瞧你说的。那当然是和千重子小姐做姐妹啦。不过，只限于秀男才……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “你太过虑了。”千重子说了这么一句，微低下头走了一段路，又说，“找个时间，咱们三人推心置腹地谈谈好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “何苦呢……话有真心，也有违心的……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，你为什么生这么大的疑心呀？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “倒不是什么疑心。但我也有一颗少女的心啊……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “大概周山那边的雷阵雨下到北山来了。山上的杉树也……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子抬起头来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “咱们快点回去吧，看样子要下雨夹雪呢。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我为防万一下雨，带着雨具来了。”千重子脱下一只手套，把手让苗子看，“这样的手，不像小姐吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子吓了一跳，连忙用自己的双手攥住千重子的那只手。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不知不觉间下起了雷阵雨。千重子不用说，恐怕就连在这个村子长大的苗子也没留意到就下起来了。不是小雨，也不是毛毛雨。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子经苗子一提醒，抬头扫视了一遍四周的山。山峦冷冷地蒙上一层蒙蒙的雨雾。挺立在山脚下的杉树，反而显得更加清新了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不知不觉间，小小的群山仿佛锁在雾霭中，渐渐失去了它的轮廓。就天空的模样来说，这种景象同春雾的景象不同。也许可以说，它更具有京都的特色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 再看看脚底下，地面上已经有点潮湿了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 不一会儿，群山弥漫了雾霭，笼上一层淡灰色。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 雾霭渐浓，从山谷落下来，还搀着一些白色的东西。这就成了雨夹雪。“快回去吧！”苗子对千重子这样说，因为她看到了这种白色的东西。这不能算是雪，只能说是雨夹雪。但是，这种白色的东西时而消失，时而又多起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子也是京都姑娘，对北山的雷阵雨并不觉得陌生。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “趁还没变成冷冷的幻影之前……”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “又是幻影？”千重子笑了，“我带雨具来了……冬天的京都天气变幻无常，可能又会停下吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子仰望着天空说：“今天还是回去吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 她紧紧地攥住千重子那只脱下手套让她瞧的手。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，你真考虑结婚吗？”千重子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “只稍稍考虑……”苗子答后，将千重子脱下的那只手套，真挚而深情地给她戴上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这时，千重子说：“请你到我店里来一趟好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “来吧！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “等店员都回家以后吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “在夜间？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子吓了一跳。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “请你在我家过夜。你的事我父母都很了解。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子的眼睛里露出了喜悦的神色。但她马上又犹豫起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我很想同你一块睡，哪怕一晚也好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子不让千重子瞧见似的把脸扭向路旁，偷偷地落起泪来。然而，千重子哪能瞧不见呢。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子回到了室町的店铺。这一带也是阴沉沉的，但没有下雨。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，你回来得正是时候，赶在下雨之前。”母亲阿繁说，“爸爸也在里屋等你哪。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子回到家里，向父亲请安，父亲没好好听完，就迫不及待地问道：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那孩子的事怎么样了，千重子？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子颇感为难，不知怎么回答才好。因为这件事用三言两语是很难说清楚的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “怎么样了？”父亲再次追问。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子对苗子的话，有的地方也是似懂非懂……苗子说，秀男实际上是想和千重子结婚，由于不能如愿，只好死了心，转念于跟千重子一模一样的苗子，并想同苗子结婚。苗子的少女心敏锐地觉察到这点。于是，她向千重子说了一通“幻影论”。千重子心想：难道秀男真的要用苗子来慰藉他渴望自己的心情吗？如果是这样，那就不算是秀男自负了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，也许事情不尽是这样。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子不好意思正面看着父亲的脸，她羞得几乎连脖子都红了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那位苗子姑娘不是一心想见你吗？”父亲说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊。”千重子猛然抬起头来，“她说大友先生家的秀男向她求婚了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子的声音微微发颤。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲悄悄望了女儿一眼，沉默了片刻。他仿佛看透了什么，但没有说出来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗，和秀男？……要是大友先生家的秀男，倒不错嘛。真的，缘分这玩意儿是很微妙的。这同你也有关系吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，不过我觉得她不会和秀男结婚。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦？那为什么呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那为什么呢？我觉得很好嘛……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，不是好不好的问题，您还记得吗，您在植物园问过我，让秀男做我的终身伴侣怎么样，这事，那位姑娘全都知道了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢？她怎么会知道的？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “还有，她好像觉得秀男家是织腰带的，同咱们的店铺总有点关系。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲感慨万分，沉默不语了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，您让她到咱家来过夜吧。过一夜也好，我求求您。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “当然可以，这有什么呢……我不是说过就是收养她也可以吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那她是绝不会同意的。她只住一个晚上……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 父亲用怜爱女儿的目光望着千重子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这时，传来了母亲拉挡雨板的声音。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “爸爸，我去帮妈一下忙就来。”千重子说着站起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 雷阵雨敲打在瓦房顶上，几乎听不见声响。父亲纹丝不动地坐在那儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 水木龙助、真一兄弟俩的父亲邀请太吉郎上圆山公园左阿弥饭馆吃晚饭。冬季日短，从高处的饭馆房间里居高临下鸟瞰，市街上都已掌灯。天空一片灰蒙蒙，没有晚霞。街上除了点点灯火，也显得阴沉沉的。那是京都冬天的色彩。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助的父亲是室町的一位殷实可靠的大批发商，他使这家字号繁荣起来。但今天他好像有难言之事，总是犹犹豫豫，净扯些无聊的市井传说来打发时间。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “其实……”他借酒兴引开了话题。平素优柔寡断，经常流露出厌世情绪的太吉郎，对水木的话却已猜到了几分。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “其实嘛……”水木吞吞吐吐地说，“关于龙助鲁莽的事，也许你已经从令爱那里听说了吧？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，我虽不才，却很理解龙助的好意。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗。”水木如释重负，“那小子很像我年轻的时候，说干就干，谁劝阻都不听，真不好办……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我倒很感谢他。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哦。你这么说，我也就放心了。”水木确实放心了，“请你别见怪啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他说完，恭恭敬敬地鞠了一躬。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎店铺的生意日渐萧条，由一个同行，且是区区年轻人来帮忙，实在有失体面。要说是去学习，从两家商店的规模看来，应该是倒过来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我倒很感谢他……”太吉郎说，“贵店倘使没有龙助，恐怕也不好办吧……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪里，做生意，龙助也是个新手，还不在行。做父亲的，说出这话未免那个，不过这孩子办事倒也牢靠……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是啊，他到敝店来，马上就摆出一副严肃的面孔坐在掌柜面前，真吓唬人。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “他就是这么个脾气。”水木说了一句，又默默地呷了一口酒。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “佐田先生。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哪怕不是每天，若答应让龙助到贵店去帮忙，他弟弟真一就会更加好好干，那我就省事了。真一是个性情温和的孩子，龙助直到现在还动不动就喊他‘童男’什么的，这是他最讨厌的……因为小时候他坐过祇园节的彩车。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “他长得很俊，和小女千重子是青梅竹马之交……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “关于千重子小姐的事……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 水木又讲不下去了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “噢，关于千重子小姐的事……”水木重复了一句，然后用简直像是生气的口吻说，“你怎样养育出这么一个漂亮的好姑娘啊？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这不是父母的本事，而是孩子天生的。”太吉郎直统统地答道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我想你已经知道了，你我都是干类似行业的，龙助要求来帮忙，说实在的，是因为他希望更多地接近千重子小姐，哪怕半个小时、一个小时也好。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 太吉郎点点头。水木揩了揩额头的汗，他那额间很像龙助的额头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那孩子虽然其貌不扬，但很能干。我决无意强求。但有朝一日有幸得到千重子小姐的垂青，真到那份上，恕我冒昧，请你把他收为养老女婿。我愿把他过继……”水木说着，低下了头。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “过继？”太吉郎简直吓了一大跳，“你要把大批发商的继承人……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是人生的不幸啊。我了解龙助近来的情况才这么想的。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “感谢你的厚意。但这种事还得根据他们两个年轻人感情的发展来定。”太吉郎避开水木的强烈要求，“千重子是个弃儿啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “弃儿有什么关系？”水木说，“我说这些，是想让你心里有个数。那么，是不是可以让龙助上贵店去帮忙呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “可以嘛。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “谢谢，谢谢。”水木感到轻松愉快了，连喝酒的样子也不同了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 第二天早上，龙助急匆匆地来到太吉郎的店里，马上就把掌柜和店员都召在一起，查起货物来……诸如香云绸、白绸、刺绣绉绸、京都绉绸、绫子、特等绉绸、捻线绸、结婚礼服、长袖和服、中袖和服、窄袖和服、锦子、缎子、高级印染绸子、出访礼服、腰带、黑绢、和服和零星物品……

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 龙助只是看了看，什么话也没说。掌柜由于有上回的事，对龙助有点拘谨，连头也没抬起来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 大家挽留龙助，可龙助还是在晚饭前回家了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 入夜，苗子来了。她砰砰砰地敲了几下格子门。这敲门声只有千重子听见。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “哎哟，苗子，从傍晚就冷了起来，你可来得太好了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “星星都出来了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，我该怎样向令尊令堂招呼才好呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我早就跟他们说明白了，只要说声你是苗子就行。”千重子搂住苗子的肩膀，领她到后院去，她边走边问：“你吃过饭了吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我在那边吃过寿司才来的，不用操心了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子显得很拘谨。千重子的双亲看见她，弄得目瞪口呆，想不到竟有这么一个姑娘长得这样像自己的女儿。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子，你们俩上后面二楼去好好谈谈吧。”还是母亲阿繁最能体贴人。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子拉着苗子的手走过狭窄的过道，上到后面二楼，打开了暖炉。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，你过来。”千重子把苗子叫到穿衣镜前，直勾勾地望着镜中两个人的脸。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “多像啊！”一股暖流流遍了千重子的全身。她们又左右对调，再看了看，“简直一模一样呀！嗯。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “本来就是双胞胎嘛。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “要是所有的人都生双胞胎，会是什么样子呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “那就净认错人，不就麻烦了吗。”苗子后退一步，眼睛湿润了，“人的命运真难预料啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子也后退到苗子身边，使劲地摇晃着苗子的双肩，说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “苗子，你就在我们家住下去不行吗？我父母也这么希望……我一个人太孤单了……虽然我不知道住在杉山会有多快活。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子好像站不稳似的摇晃了一下，跪坐了下来，然后摇摇头。在摇头的当儿，眼泪差点落在自己的膝盖上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐。现在你我之间的生活方式不同，教养也不一样，我也过不惯大城市生活，我只要上你店来一次，只要一次也就行了。也想让你看看你送给我的和服……再说，小姐还曾两次光临杉山看我。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “小姐，你婴儿时被我们的父母抛弃了，可我什么都不晓得呀。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这种事，我早就忘记了。”千重子无拘无束地说，“现在我已经不认为有这样的父母了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我想，不知道咱们的父母是不是受到了报应……那时我也是个婴儿。请别见怪。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这事你有什么责任和罪过呢？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “虽然没有，但我以前也说过，我不愿意妨碍小姐的幸福，哪怕是一星半点。”苗子压低嗓音，“我想索性隐姓埋名算了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “何苦呢，干吗要那样……”千重子加强了语气，“我总觉得很不公平……苗子，你觉得不幸福吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “不，我觉得孤单。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “也许幸运是短暂的，而孤单却是长久的。”千重子说，“咱们躺下好好再谈谈吧。”她从壁橱里拿出卧具来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子一边帮忙一边说：“这就是幸福吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 她侧耳倾听屋顶上的声音。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子看见苗子侧耳倾听，便问道：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是雷阵雨？雨夹雪？还是夹杂着雨雪的阵雨？”说着自己也停下手来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是吗？可能是下小雪吧。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “多么轻飘啊。不成雪的雪。真好，是小小的雪。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “山村里经常下这样的小雪。我们在干活，不知不觉间，杉树的叶子披上了一层白色，就像是一朵朵白花。冬天枯萎的林木，常常连小小的枝丫都成了白色，好看极了。”苗子说。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “有时小雪很快停下，马上变成雨夹雪，有时又变成雷阵雨……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “打开挡雨板看看怎么样？一看就明白了。”千重子刚想站起来走过去，就被苗子一把抱住，“算了，又那么冷，要幻灭的啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “幻、幻，你总爱说个幻字。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子美丽的脸蛋绽开了微笑，流露出一缕淡淡的哀愁。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子要铺床铺，苗子急忙说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐，请让我来铺一次小姐你的床铺好吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是千重子一声不言，默默地钻进并排铺着的被窝里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “啊！苗子，真暖和啊！”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “毕竟是工作不同，住的地方也……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子把千重子紧紧抱住。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这样的夜晚，总是很冷的啊。”苗子似乎一点也不觉得冷，“细雪纷纷扬扬，停停下下……今天夜里……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这时，父亲太吉郎和母亲阿繁上楼到隔壁房间去了。由于上了年纪，他们用电热毯去暖和床铺。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子把嘴凑到千重子耳边，悄悄地说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “千重子小姐的床铺已经暖和了，我到旁边的铺位去。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 母亲把隔扇拉开一条小缝，窥视两个姑娘的卧室，那是在这以后的事了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 翌日早晨，苗子一早就起床，把千重子摇醒：“小姐，这可能就是我一生的幸福了。趁着没人瞧见，我该回去了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 正像昨晚苗子所说的那样，真正的小雪在半夜里下下停停，现在还在霏霏地下着。这是一个寒冷的早晨。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 千重子坐了起来。“苗子，你没带雨具吧？请你等一等。”千重子说着，把自己最好的天鹅绒大衣、折叠伞和高齿木屐都给了苗子。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “这是我送给你的。希望你再来啊。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 苗子摇摇头。千重子抓住红格子门，目送苗子远去。苗子始终没有回头。在千重子的前发上飘落了少许细雪，很快就消融了。整个市街也还在沉睡着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 第二十一世本因坊秀哉名人， [1] 于昭和十五年一月十八日早晨，在热海鳞屋旅馆与世长辞，享年六十七岁。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 在热海，一月十八日这个忌辰的日子，是很容易记牢的。因为《金色夜叉》中的贯一在热海海边说了一句“本月今晚的月亮”的台词，人们为了纪念他，便把一月十七日定为红叶节。秀哉名人的忌辰，就是红叶节的次日。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 历年红叶节都举办文学性的活动。名人逝世的昭和十五年，红叶节尤为盛大。除尾崎红叶外，还有高山樗牛、坪内逍遥，都同热海结下了不解之缘。为了悼念这三位已故文人，竹田敏彦、大佛次郎、林房雄等三位小说家在前一年度的作品里又对热海作了介绍。热海市给这三位作家赠送了感谢状。当时我正在热海，也出席了这个节日的活动。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 十七日晚上，市长在我下榻的聚乐旅馆举行了招待宴会。十八日凌晨，我被电话吵醒，说是名人作古了，我旋即奔赴鳞屋去吊唁，然后折回旅馆。吃过早饭，同前来参加红叶节的作家和市工作人员一起参谒了逍遥的墓，并供奉了鲜花。而后绕到梅园去。在抚松庵举行的宴会上，我中途溜了出来，去鳞屋给名人的遗容拍了一张照片。过不多久，就目送名人的遗体被运回东京去了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 名人是在一月十五日到达热海的，十八日就猝然长逝了。好像特地到热海来作古似的。十六日我曾到旅馆造访名人，并下了两盘棋。当天傍晚，我回家不久，名人突然发病了。这是名人最后一次同我下他所爱好的将棋。我撰写过一篇秀哉名人最后一场比赛（告别赛）的观战记，还同名人最后对弈了一盘，拍了一张名人最后的头像（遗容）。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 名人同我结下缘分，是从东京日日（每日）新闻社选我当告别赛观战记者开始的。作为报社举办的围棋赛，那次场面之盛大空前绝后。六月二十六日在芝公园的红叶馆开始对局，到十二月四日在伊东的暖香园下完这一盘棋，几乎花费了半年的时光。断断续续地下了十四次。我在报上连载了六十四回观战记。不过，棋下到一半，名人便病倒了。八月中旬到十一月中旬休战了三个月。由于名人病重，这盘棋更显得悲切了。说不定还是这盘棋夺去了名人的性命呢。下完这盘棋，名人再也没能恢复健康，一年后就离开了人世。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [1] 本因坊，1590年丰臣秀吉授予棋艺高超的日海和尚“本因坊”称号，开始了“本因坊”世袭制。名人，棋手的最高称号。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这位名人下完告别赛的时间，确切地说，应该是昭和十三年十二月四日下午二时四十二分。下到黑237就终局了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 且说名人默默地在棋盘上“收官”，这时，列席的小野田六段说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “是五目吗？”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这是很有礼貌的说法。他明知名人输了五目，却有意这么说，以图消除名人的忧郁，这也许是对名人的一种体贴吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “嗯，是五目……”名人嘟哝了一句，抬起红肿的眼睑，他已经再也不想摆放棋子了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 拥到对局室来的工作人员，谁都不言语。名人仿佛要缓和一下这种沉闷的气氛，平静地说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “我不入院的话，早该在八月中旬就在箱根结束了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 然后，他询问了自己用的时间。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “白方是十九小时五十七分……还差三分钟，正好用一半时间。”担任记录的少女棋手回答道。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “黑方是三十四小时十九分……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 高段棋手下一盘棋，一般需要十个小时的光景。唯独这盘棋，据说规定可用时四十小时，等于延长四倍。最后黑方实际用时三十四小时十九分，耗时相当多。自从围棋规定时间以来，这一盘是空前绝后的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 下完这盘棋，正好快到三点，旅馆女佣端上了点心。人们依然沉默不语，视线都落在棋盘上。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “吃点年糕小豆汤怎么样？”名人问对手大竹七段。 [1]

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 年轻的七段下完棋，就向名人施礼说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “先生，谢谢您了。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 说罢，他深深地低下了头，一动也不动，双手端端正正地放在膝上，白皙的脸显得更加苍白了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 名人抹乱了棋盘上的棋子，七段将黑子放进棋盒里。对于对手，名人没说一句感想，像平时一样，若无其事地站起来走了。当然，七段也没吐露什么感想。倘使是七段输了，总该说点什么吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 我也回到自己的房间，偶尔探望一下外面，发现大竹七段动作麻利，转眼换上了棉袍，下到庭院，独自坐在对面的长凳上。他紧抱双臂，耷拉下苍白的脸。冬日临近黄昏，暮霭朦胧，他在冷飕飕的宽阔庭院里，陷入了沉思。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 我打开了走廊的玻璃门，呼唤道：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “大竹兄，大竹兄。”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 他生气似的稍微掉转头，大概是落泪了吧。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 我把目光移退回屋里，名人夫人来致意说：

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “承蒙长期多方关照……”

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 我同夫人交谈了几句，大竹七段的身影早已从庭院消失了。接着他又麻利地换上带家徽的礼服，衣冠整齐地带着自己的妻子到名人和工作人员的房间去致意，也到我的房间来了。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 我也到名人的房间去致意。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: [1] 这场告别赛实是本因坊秀哉与著名棋手木谷实七段对弈的。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 这盘棋下了半年，胜负终于揭晓。次日工作人员也都急匆匆地回家去了。恰巧是伊东线试车的前一天。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 年终岁初，是温泉的旺季。电车通到伊东市，大街小巷都披上了庆贺的新装，显出一派繁荣景象。我同被“禁闭”的棋手们一起幽居在旅馆的房间里。当我乘上公共汽车回家时，这个城市的装饰跳入眼帘，使我觉得像是从洞窟中解放出来似的。新车站附近，展现出一条条土色的未经铺设的路。突击建筑的房屋，一栋栋拔地而起。新街区杂乱无章。在我看来，这是人世间的一种生机。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 公共汽车驶出伊东市，在海滨路上，遇上了一群背着柴火的妇女，她们手里拿着贯众草。有的妇女用贯众草把柴火捆绑起来。我突然觉得人是可亲的，心情就像越过高山看见了缭绕上升的炊烟一样。可以说这些寻常准备过年的生活习惯，令我十分怀念。我恍如从异常的世界逃脱了出来。妇女们大概是拾柴火回家烧饭吧。海呈现出一派冬日的景色。太阳显得暗淡无光，突然昏沉下来。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 但是，就是在公共汽车上，我的脑子里还浮现着名人的形象。也许是对老名人产生的感情渗透了身心，才使我感到可亲可敬。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 工作人员一个个都走了，只剩下老名人夫妇留在伊东旅馆里。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: “常胜名人”在一生中最后一次的围棋赛上败北了。因此名人应该最不愿意在对局室里停留。再说，他带病参战，要消除疲劳，也应该尽早换个地方才是。然而难道是名人对此心不在焉，或是感觉迟钝？连工作人员和观战的我，都觉得再不能在这里待下去，赶紧逃脱似的回家去了，唯独失利的名人却留下来。他这种郁闷而乏味的生活，任凭人们去想象吧。他本人大概依然像往常一样若无其事，茫然地坐着。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 名人的对手大竹七段早已回家去了。他和没有孩子的名人不同，有一个热闹的家庭。

author: 川端康成
book_description: Yasunari Kawabata, The Old Capital; Chinese source with generated Japanese comment text.

paragraphs.text: 记得下完这盘棋两三年之后，我曾接到大竹七段夫人的来信，提到他家有十六口人。我想，在一个十六口人的大家庭里，或许可以领略到七段的性格或生活作风，便想去拜访他家。后来，七段的父亲去世，十六口人变成了十五口，我曾去吊唁。虽说是吊唁，也是在举行过葬礼一个月以后才去的。这是我第一次拜访七段的家。七段不在，夫人亲切地接待了我，把我请进了客厅。夫人寒暄过后，站到门口去了。
